items.title: Poll worker markings don't void US ballots
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: US election officials and experts say ballots are not automatically invalidated if poll workers write on them, countering misleading social media posts that have resurfaced ahead of the November 3 midterm elections.
items.body:
US election officials and experts say ballots are not automatically invalidated if poll workers write on them, countering misleading social media posts that have [USN:L6N3M00KY TEXT:"resurfaced"] ahead of the November 3 midterm elections.
Posts online have warned voters that any poll-worker markings will result in ballots being disqualified
Election officials and experts say poll workers often have legitimate reasons to write on ballots. Illinois law, for example, requires election judges to initial ballots before issuing them and state officials say this practice does not invalidate votes
The North Carolina State Board of Elections said in an October 14 statement that poll workers mark ballots "for different reasons as required by law" and that such markings do not affect whether a ballot is counted. It added that social media posts claiming otherwise have circulated for years and "are still false"
Election officials in Illinois and Tennessee have also issued similar statements confirming that ballot markings by election workers do not invalidate ballots
Verified Voting, a nonpartisan election monitoring group, told Reuters that ballots may be marked "duplicated" if the original is damaged, with a serial number linking the replacement ballot to the original
County officials in Florida and New Mexico have also said writing on a ballot does not automatically disqualify it and that ballots unreadable by tabulators can be counted by hand
Marks made by voters that could identify them, such as signatures, initials or ID numbers, may invalidate a ballot under some state laws, Verified Voting said in an email
Verdict: Misleading. Writing or markings on ballots by poll workers do not automatically invalidate them
This article was produced by the Reuters Fact Check team. Read more about our fact-checking work.

items.title: Länder fordern vom Bund bis 2031 zusätzlich 14 Milliarden für Nahverkehr
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Die Länder fordern nach der Verkehrsministerkonferenz bis 2031 zusätzlich 14 Milliarden Euro vom Bund. Sie bräuchten die Mittel, um in den nächsten Jahren den Status quo im öffentlichen Nahverkehr erhalten zu können, sagte der bayerische Ressortchef Christian Bernreiter (CSU) am Donnerstag in Hohenschwangau unweit von Füssen. Sonst drohten Preissteigerungen und im Notfall müsste das Angebot eingeschränkt werden. Das könnte eine Abwärtsspirale auslösen. Der Bund lehnt die Forderung allerdings ab. Auch bei der geplanten Reform der Schienenmaut blieb er konkrete Details schuldig.
items.body:
Die Länder fordern nach der Verkehrsministerkonferenz bis 2031 zusätzlich 14 Milliarden Euro vom Bund. Sie bräuchten die Mittel, um in den nächsten Jahren den Status quo im öffentlichen Nahverkehr erhalten zu können, sagte der bayerische Ressortchef Christian Bernreiter (CSU) am Donnerstag in Hohenschwangau unweit von Füssen. Sonst drohten Preissteigerungen und im Notfall müsste das Angebot eingeschränkt werden. Das könnte eine Abwärtsspirale auslösen. Der Bund lehnt die Forderung allerdings ab. Auch bei der geplanten Reform der Schienenmaut blieb er konkrete Details schuldig.
Der Europäische Gerichtshof (EuGH) hatte im März mit einem Urteil die Trassenpreisbremse in Deutschland für den Nahverkehr gekippt. Dieser muss nun dieses Jahr 400 Millionen Euro zusätzlich als Schienenmaut aufbringen. Im Gegenzug werden Fern- und Güterverkehr in dieser Größenordnung entlastet, weil sie bisher zu viel zahlen mussten. Bernreiter sagte, der Bund müsse die Länder für die zu erwartenden Mehrkosten kompensieren. "Bisher habe ich vom Bundesfinanzminister dahingehend nur Absagen erhalten. Aber wir lassen uns nicht entmutigen." Es werde weiter gekämpft.
Bundesverkehrsminister Steffen Bilger (CDU) verwies darauf, dass die Möglichkeiten in seinem Etat begrenzt seien. Der [USN:L8N4681FL TEXT:"neuen Steuerschätzung"] zufolge können Bund, Länder und Gemeinden bis 2030 insgesamt mit 43,4 Milliarden Euro höheren Einnahmen als noch im Frühjahr rechnen. Der Bund profitiert davon allerdings nur in geringem Umfang. Vor allem Länder und Kommunen erhalten mehr Geld.
Im Beschlusspapier der Verkehrsministerkonferenz heißt es, es müsse unverzüglich ein verbindlicher Bund-Länder-Prozess zur Reform des Trassenpreissystems eingeleitet werden. Bilger hatte zuletzt eine baldige Reform in Aussicht gestellt. Er sagte, es sei ihm wichtig gewesen, zunächst mit den Ländern zu sprechen. Das EuGH-Urteil werde der Bund umsetzen, die erhofften finanziellen Zusagen der Länder habe er aber nicht dabei. Der Bund stelle bereits Milliarden zur Verfügung, investiere so stark wie nie in die marode Infrastruktur und tue alles, um die Trassenpreise zu dämpfen.
BAHN IN DER PFLICHT Bahn-Chefin Evelyn Palla nahm an der Konferenz teil. Bilger nahm vor allem die Infrastrukturtochter des Staatskonzerns in die Pflicht. Die DB InfraGO müsse ihre Mittel effizient einsetzen. Aktuell liefen die letzten Verhandlungen zu den Leistungsvereinbarungen mit der DB InfraGO. Dort werde festgeschrieben, wie mehr als 80 Milliarden Euro konkret in den kommenden fünf Jahren ins Schienennetz fließen sollten. Ziel sei es, die Bahn zuverlässiger und pünktlicher zu machen, was eine große Herausforderung sei. "Wir können keine Wunder vollbringen." In einigen Jahren sollten die Kunden aber spüren, dass es vorangehe.
DB-InfraGO-Chef Philipp Nagl sagte der "Zeit", dass die Zahl der Verspätungsfälle, die mit gestörten Infrastrukturanlagen zusammenhingen, 2026 um 40 Prozent gestiegen sei. Er verwies auf einen kalten Winter und heißen Sommer. "Extreme Temperaturen beschädigen die Infrastruktur und verhindern schnelle Reparaturen. Wenn man ganz Deutschland betrachtet, gehen die Weichen, Oberleitungen und Stellwerke im Moment immer noch schneller kaputt, als wir sie repariert bekommen."
Bilger forderte erneut, dass die Sanierungen vielbelasteter Abschnitte besser werden müssten, sodass diese nach monatelanger Sperrung deutlich weniger störanfällig seien. Deswegen wurde der Zeitplan dafür zuletzt gestreckt, um nicht zu viele Vollsperrungen pro Jahr zu haben.
Die Länder beschlossen zudem, wegen des Niedrigwassers an Rhein und Donau die Ausnahmen für Lkw vom Sonn- und Feiertagsfahrverbot zu verlängern. Diese sollen nun bis zum 20. Dezember gelten, also kurz vor Weihnachten.
Keine Einigung gab es bei der Idee, als Ergänzung zum Deutschlandticket für gelegentliche Bus- und Bahnfahrer ein bundesweites Digitalangebot zu schaffen. Bernreiter sagte, es könne die Gefahr bestehen, dass Personen mit Deutschlandticket abspringen. Deswegen sei das Thema auf Frühjahr vertagt worden. Es gebe kein Geld für Leistungsausweitungen. Nordrhein-Westfalen und Hamburg plädieren dafür, sich per Smartphone zu Beginn und Ende einer Fahrt zu registrieren, damit dann automatisch der günstigste Tarif berechnet wird. Der Grünen-Politiker Oliver Krischer sagte, NRW habe damit gute Erfahrungen gemacht. Es gehe hier um Gelegenheitsfahrer, für die es leichter werden müsse. Sie sollten nicht verwirrt vor Automaten stehen und sich mit komplizierten Tarifen auseinandersetzen.

items.title: Vendedores en corto se embolsan 6.000 millones de dólares con la caída de las "neocloud"
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Los inversionistas que han apostado en contra de las empresas estadounidenses de "neocloud" y centros de datos han obtenido 6.000 millones de dólares en beneficios contables en lo que va de mes, gracias a una ola de ventas desencadenada por los temores a que la expansión del sector de la IA, impulsada por deuda, se estuviera volviendo insostenible.
items.body:
Los inversionistas que han apostado en contra de las empresas estadounidenses de "neocloud" y centros de datos han obtenido 6.000 millones de dólares en beneficios contables en lo que va de mes, gracias a una ola de ventas desencadenada por los temores a que la expansión del sector de la IA, impulsada por deuda, se estuviera volviendo insostenible.
La posición corta en CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , IREN (IREN.O) , Nebius Group (NBIS.O) , Applied Digital (APLD.O) y Core Scientific (CORZ.O) osciló entre el 20% y el 26% de su capital flotante, según la empresa de análisis de datos ORTEX.
El interés corto actual en CoreWeave se sitúa en el 23,7% de su capital flotante, frente al 19,6% registrado a principios de mes, aunque ligeramente superior al 22,7% observado a principios de 2026.
Los vendedores en corto han obtenido cerca de 1.700 millones de dólares en beneficios contables con las operaciones de CoreWeave en lo que va de mes, tras la caída de casi el 30% que han sufrido las acciones de la empresa.
La posición corta en Nebius ha subido hasta el 20% del capital flotante, desde el 15,4% registrado a principios de 2026.
Los inversionistas que apuestan en contra de Nebius han obtenido 2.940 millones de dólares en beneficios contables en lo que va de octubre, aunque han registrado una pérdida contable de 3.330 millones de dólares en lo que va de año.
Los vendedores en corto de los operadores de centros de datos IREN (IREN.O) y Applied Digital (APLD.O) han registrado unas ganancias contables combinadas de más de 1.200 millones de dólares en lo que va de mes.
La empresa de centros de datos Core Scientific (CORZ.O) también presentaba un elevado interés en posiciones cortas, del 23,1% de su capital flotante, y los vendedores en corto obtuvieron 115 millones de dólares en beneficios contables en octubre.
En conjunto, actualmente hay unos 17.000 millones de dólares en acciones de estas cinco empresas vendidas en corto y el costo del préstamo sigue siendo bajo para todas ellas, según ORTEX.

items.title: Publishers, advertisers call EU, UK antitrust regulators to suspend Meta's new commercial terms
items.author: Yun Chee Foo
items.creator: Yun Chee Foo
items.summary: Digital advertisers and publishers lobbied on Thursday for EU and UK regulators to suspend Meta Platforms' new commercial terms due to come into effect on October 30, alleging that these would give Meta an unlimited right to use their content for its AI services.
items.body:
Digital advertisers and publishers lobbied on Thursday for EU and UK regulators to suspend Meta Platforms' (META.O) new commercial terms due to come into effect on October 30, alleging that these would give Meta an unlimited right to use their content for its AI services.
Advocacy group the Movement for an Open Web, whose members include digital advertisers and publishers, said it had complained to the European Commission and the UK's Competition and Markets Authority and requested interim measures.
Publishers worldwide are stepping up their fight with AI companies that use their content without permission to train large language models, underscoring the clash between copyright owners and those citing fair use arguments.
"Meta's new terms are clearly anti-competitive. Many businesses effectively have no choice but to use Meta's services and these conditions would force them to sign away the rights to their digital content with no means of opting out," Tim Cowen, co-founder of the Movement for an Open Web, said.
"The terms would give Meta a free hand to scrape content from nearly every website in the world, potentially using that data to power AI-powered services that would then compete with those businesses," he said.
Meta said it disagreed with the complaint.
"The crawling terms we consolidated only applied to our ads and business products, and we've clarified that in the terms themselves. It does not change how Meta uses web crawlers," a Meta spokesperson said.
"As always, content owners can use robots.txt to signal their preferences. This is not about scraping news sites, and these updates don't give us new rights that supersede those preferences."
The CMA said it met with Meta on Wednesday to get more details on its new business terms.

items.title: Un Ukrainien, soupçonné d'espionnage pour la Russie, arrêté en Allemagne
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Un ressortissant ukrainien a été arrêté dans le nord-est de l'Allemagne, soupçonné d'espionnage au profit de la Russie, selon un communiqué publié jeudi par le parquet fédéral.
items.body:
Un ressortissant ukrainien a été arrêté dans le nord-est de l'Allemagne, soupçonné d'espionnage au profit de la Russie, selon un communiqué publié jeudi par le parquet fédéral.
L'individu, arrêté dans le Land de Brandebourg et identifié par le parquet sous le nom de Vadym Y., était en contact avec un service secret russe via un intermédiaire depuis juillet 2025 au plus tard, ont précisé les procureurs.
Il recueillait des renseignements militaires, notamment des informations sur la production de véhicules blindés, de munitions et d’explosifs, ainsi que sur le personnel et les installations militaires situées dans des zones destinées à sécuriser le flanc est de l’Otan, ont-ils précisé.
Tandis que certaines informations étaient disponibles publiquement, d’autres détails ont été obtenus auprès de personnes travaillant dans l’industrie européenne de la défense, ont-ils précisé.
Selon le communiqué, l’accusé comparaîtra vendredi devant le juge d’instruction de la Cour fédérale de justice, qui lui remettra le mandat d’arrêt et se prononcera sur le placement en détention provisoire.
Des médias allemands ont été les premiers à relayer cette information.

BRUSSELS, Oct 22 : Digital advertisers and publishers lobbied on Thursday for EU and UK regulators to suspend Meta Platforms' new commercial terms due to come into effect on October 30, alleging that these would give Meta an unlimited right to use their content for its AI services.
Advocacy group the Movement for an Open Web, whose members include digital advertisers and publishers, said it had complained to the European Commission and the UK's Competition and Markets Authority and requested interim measures.
Publishers worldwide are stepping up their fight with AI companies that use their content without permission to train large language models, underscoring the clash between copyright owners and those citing fair use arguments.
"Meta's new terms are clearly anti-competitive. Many businesses effectively have no choice but to use Meta's services and these conditions would force them to sign away the rights to their digital content with no means of opting out," Tim Cowen, co-founder of the Movement for an Open Web, said.

The CMA said it met with Meta on Wednesday to get more details on its new business terms.

items.title: Heidelberg Materials puts German carbon capture project on hold
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Heidelberg Materials , one of the world's largest cement makers, has paused its carbon capture plant project in Geseke, Germany, because the current framework conditions do not support a viable business case, it said on Thursday.
items.body:
Heidelberg Materials (HEIG.DE) , one of the world's largest cement makers, has paused its carbon capture plant project in Geseke, Germany, because the current framework conditions do not support a viable business case, it said on Thursday.
GeZero was planned as Germany's first inland cement plant that would deploy scalable carbon capture technology
"As a listed company, we will only pursue CO2 capture if we have a stable, sound business case for it. We do not yet have that in Geseke," CEO Dominik von Achten told Reuters, adding putting the project on hold had been a "tough but right decision"
The decision applies only to the GeZero project - which has received €191 million ($214 million) in EU funding - and will have no immediate impact on operations at the company's Geseke plant
It cited insufficiently developed CO2 transport, storage infrastructure and value chains as reasons for the halt
Heidelberg Materials plans to further optimize the design of the project
($1 = 0.8933 euros)

Oct 22 : Nippon Steel will invest about $3 billion in the U.S. Steel-operated Mon Valley works in Pennsylvania to upgrade the plant's hot rolling facility, the Nikkei newspaper reported on Thursday.
The move is part of the Japanese steelmaker's pledge to invest $11 billion in U.S. Steel by 2028, following its acquisition of the company in 2025.
Nippon Steel did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours.
Mon Valley's hot rolling equipment, which heats slabs of iron from blast furnaces and rolls them into thinner steel, has been in operation for about 90 years, Nikkei added.
The new equipment is set to enter operation in the second half of 2029, which would enable production of higher-quality steel, the report said.
Nippon Steel raised its fiscal 2026 earnings forecast in August, lifted by stronger U.S. Steel earnings and a firm steel market.

items.title: Gaza-Trois Palestiniens tués par des frappes israéliennes - secours
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Des frappes et des tirs israéliens ont tué au moins trois Palestiniens jeudi, dans deux incidents séparés survenus dans la bande Gaza, selon les autorités sanitaires locales.
items.body:
Des frappes et des tirs israéliens ont tué au moins trois Palestiniens jeudi, dans deux incidents séparés survenus dans la bande Gaza, selon les autorités sanitaires locales.
Ces dernières ont précisé qu'une frappe aérienne israélienne sur une voiture a tué au moins une personne dans la ville de Gaza.
À Khan Younès, dans le sud de la bande de Gaza, les secouristes ont dit qu'un homme palestinien à vélo avait été tué par une frappe tandis que des tirs israéliens ont tué une femme à proximité du camp de réfugiés de Jabaliya, dans le nord.
L'armée israélienne n'a pas commenté aucun de ces incidents dans l'immédiat.
Israël, qui affirme que le Hamas s'est réarmé et lance des attaques en violation du cessez-le-feu conclu en octobre 2025, a intensifié ses frappes contre le mouvement ces dernières semaines.
Le Hamas nie tenter de mener des attaques ou de reconstituer son arsenal et accuse Israël de violer ce cessez-le-feu et de saper les efforts pour mettre en oeuvre le plan du président américain Donald Trump pour mettre fin au conflit dans la bande de Gaza.
Ce plan prévoit entre autres le retrait d'Israël et le désarmement du Hamas.
Le cessez-le-feu d'octobre 2025 a mis fin aux combats dans la bande de Gaza, engagés par l'armée israélienne en réponse à l'attaque menée le 7 octobre 2023 par le Hamas dans le sud d'Israël.
Cette attaque du Hamas avait fait environ 1.200 morts et entraîné l'enlèvement de 251 otages emmenés à Gaza. Les autorités palestiniennes affirment que plus de 74.000 personnes ont été tuées lors de l'offensive israélienne qui s'en est suivie.
Plus de 1.500 Palestiniens ont été tués par Israël dans l'enclave depuis l'entrée en vigueur du cessez-le-feu il y a un an, selon les autorités sanitaires locales, tandis que Tsahal a fait état de la mort de quatre soldats israéliens.
items.raw_description: Des frappes et des tirs israéliens ont tué au moins trois Palestiniens jeudi, dans deux incidents séparés survenus dans la bande Gaza, selon les autorités sanitaires locales.

items.title: Nippon Steel to spend $3 billion in U.S. Steel plant equipment upgrade, Nikkei reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Nippon Steel will invest about $3 billion in the U.S. Steel-operated Mon Valley works in Pennsylvania to upgrade the plant's hot rolling facility, the Nikkei newspaper reported on Thursday.
items.body:
Nippon Steel (5401.T) will invest about $3 billion in the U.S. Steel-operated Mon Valley works in Pennsylvania to upgrade the plant's hot rolling facility, the Nikkei newspaper reported on Thursday.
The move is part of the Japanese steelmaker's pledge to invest $11 billion in U.S. Steel by 2028, following its acquisition of the company in 2025.
Nippon Steel did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours.
Mon Valley's hot rolling equipment, which heats slabs of iron from blast furnaces and rolls them into thinner steel, has been in operation for about 90 years, Nikkei added.
The new equipment is set to enter operation in the second half of 2029, which would enable production of higher-quality steel, the report said.
Nippon Steel [USN:L1N44109O TEXT:"raised"] its fiscal 2026 earnings forecast in August, lifted by stronger U.S. Steel earnings and a firm steel market.

FAST

Oct 22 : Anyone who has watched a manta ray glide over a reef knows how unhurried these marine animals can look. Yet researchers working off Costa Rica found their movements are varied, with juveniles staying nearby and close to shore while adults venture hundreds of kilometres.
Manta rays are among the ocean's largest fish, with wing-like fins that can span up to about 8 meters (26 feet) and the largest brain of any fish.
Researchers tracked endangered oceanic manta rays between 2018 and 2025, fitting 59 of them with acoustic transmitters and tracking 12 with satellite tags, along with photo identification. 
"By combining different technologies ... we were able to piece together a highly detailed map of their movements and their use of coastal cleaning stations," said Jeffry Madrigal-Mesén, director of the research group Mantas Costa Rica and lead author of the study published in the journal Frontiers in Fish Science.

A coastal cleaning station is a rocky reef site where small fish remove parasites from the skin of the manta rays in an example of symbiotic behaviour.
Researchers found that smaller, immature mantas stayed within Costa Rica's coastal waters, called its exclusive economic zone. Larger, mature animals undertook long-distance journeys, some reaching as far as the waters off Guatemala.
"This makes us believe that smaller mantas do not risk these long migrations, likely due to the threat of large predators like orcas and tiger sharks," Madrigal-Mesén said.
The smaller animals in the study measured around 3 to 3.5 meters across (10 to 11.5 feet), compared with around 4 to 4.5 meters (13 to 15 feet) for those making the longer journeys.
DANGER FROM PREDATORS
A juvenile, at around 3 meters across, would still appear enormous to most swimmers. Yet that size may not be enough protection.
Madrigal-Mesén said that "their massive size is one of their main defence mechanisms. It is quite common to see animals missing portions of their bodies, and in many cases, the shape of the wounds strongly suggests they are bites from other large marine predators."
What prompts mantas to eventually join the migratory population remains unclear, although researchers suspect that reaching feeding and breeding grounds in highly productive waters across Central America may play a role.
The manta rays also repeatedly return to the same coastal cleaning stations. Observations of feeding, courtship and recent mating suggest these sites may also function as social hubs. Scientists do not yet know how mantas navigate back to particular sites.
"Based on the bathymetry of the different sites we monitor, there must be a relationship with the rock formations. We humans have favourite places we like to go to," Madrigal-Mesén said. "Why couldn't mantas have a preference for one cleaning station over another?"
The findings also suggest the mantas may not roam as far as once thought. Researchers initially suspected that animals seen in Costa Rica might migrate from populations in Ecuador or Mexico. The tracking data instead raises the possibility that Central America has its own distinct population, something the team is now investigating through genetic work.
Mantas are particularly vulnerable because, like other rays and sharks, they reproduce slowly and take years to reach sexual maturity. Madrigal-Mesén said that once the animals left Cocos Island, a volcanic island in the Pacific Ocean, and most monitored coastal sites, they entered waters with no protection, exposing them to threats including fishing and vessel traffic.
"Studies like this help us recognise that these coastal havens only protect them for a specific time of the year. ... This is why it is so critical to protect the marine corridors these migratory species travel through."
Coastal mantas also showed strong site fidelity, with very few moving between monitoring sites even when they were only tens of kilometres apart. 
One male became a particularly striking example. Nicknamed "Mickey Mouse" for its distinctive spot pattern, the ray was repeatedly photographed at Cabo Blanco and tracked using both satellite and acoustic tags, showing a strong attachment to the site. 
But researchers have not seen this ray in Costa Rica for more than a year. 
"We have a lot of affection for him," Madrigal-Mesén added. "We hope he comes back soon."

Source: Reuters

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 22 : The yen was on track for its strongest daily gain in almost a month on Thursday, as investors sought safety amid fragile equity markets, elevated crude prices from the drawn-out war in the Middle East, and doubts over future returns from artificial intelligence.
The US dollar, meanwhile, rose against the euro. Worries about social unrest in France and a worsening fiscal outlook for the country outweighed concerns about the AI trade, which pushed US stocks lower.
"AI is making people nervous, as is oil ... and as is France, and obviously we have a slight degree of risk aversion in the market," said Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets.
Brent crude climbed to its highest level since May after further Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia raised fears of an escalation in the Middle East conflict and more disruption to oil supplies from the key exporting region.

The Japanese yen strengthened 0.51 per cent to 157.33 per dollar. 
The Swiss franc, another traditional safe haven, was little changed at 0.824 per dollar.
The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies including the yen and the euro, rose 0.14 per cent to 101.82, with the euro down 0.3 per cent at $1.1198.
The dollar has become increasingly tied to capital flows and to growth and inflation expectations linked to the AI trade. It fell last week as fears over the AI outlook grew. On Thursday, however, concerns about France outweighed those fears.
“You have these competing stories and weak points between US AI-related credits and then France sovereign credit, and we've seen this push and pull in the last couple of days where at times one is more of a concern than the other,” said Erik Nelson, global head of FX strategy at Wells Fargo. “As long as France is more of a concern than US AI credits, then you're going to see the euro underperform.”
French President Emmanuel Macron vowed on Wednesday to prevent a repeat of last weekend's violence at protests planned in the coming days, and dismissed as "stupid" and "unacceptable" comments from some foreign leaders about the unrest.
Concerns about France's ability to manage its huge debt burden have hurt French government bonds and raised worries about other heavily indebted euro zone countries. The spread between France and Germany's 10-year note yields reached 177.7 basis points on Thursday, the widest gap since 2011.
Sterling weakened 0.18 per cent to $1.337. The Australian dollar fell 0.21 per cent to $0.7012.
In cryptocurrencies, bitcoin fell 3.20 per cent to $81,929. 
(Additional reporting by Amanda Cooper and Tom Westbrook; Editing by Xevi Fontdegloria)

Source: Reuters

items.title: Former presidential candidate Gonzalez arrested in Ecuador
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ecuador's former presidential candidate Luisa Gonzalez has been arrested, the head of the leftist Citizens Revolution party, Gabriela Rivadeneira, said on Thursday.
items.body:
Ecuador's former presidential candidate Luisa Gonzalez has been arrested, the head of the leftist Citizens Revolution party, Gabriela Rivadeneira, said on Thursday.
Gonzalez, an ally of former President Rafael Correa, is under investigation over alleged irregularities in political financing and campaign spending.
She has previously said that her party submitted its 2023 presidential campaign spending to the electoral authority and that the prosecutor's office has no evidence to support its accusations.
Gonzalez lost the snap election to President Daniel Noboa.
"They arrested Luisa Gonzalez. ENOUGH IS ENOUGH!," Correa shared on X.

items.title: Consejo Superior de Deportes español pide a tribunal que revise dichos de jefe de LaLiga sobre Real Madrid
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El Consejo Superior de Deportes (CSD) pidió a un tribunal deportivo que considere las declaraciones del presidente de LaLiga, Javier Tebas, en que comparó la estrategia de comunicación del Real Madrid con la propaganda nazi.
items.body:
El Consejo Superior de Deportes (CSD) pidió a un tribunal deportivo que considere las declaraciones del presidente de LaLiga, Javier Tebas, en que comparó la estrategia de comunicación del Real Madrid con la propaganda nazi.
El CSD solicitó al tribunal que evalúe si las declaraciones pueden haber infringido las normas que protegen la dignidad y el decoro deportivos.
Tebas hizo los comentarios el viernes en las redes sociales y, en respuesta, el Real Madrid emitió un comunicado en el que pedía la dimisión inmediata de Tebas, de 64 años.
Tebas dijo que no estaba comparando la ideología del Real Madrid ni la de su afición con las del Partido Nazi, sino únicamente las técnicas de propaganda del club.
Las sanciones por este tipo de infracciones incluyen amonestaciones, multas o posibles suspensiones.
LaLiga no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios.

items.body:
Infineum, a UK-based chemicals group backed by Shell (SHEL.L) , is exploring an $8 billion sale, the Financial Times reported on Thursday, as the energy major tries to refocus on its core oil and gas operations.
The chemicals group, which is owned by Shell and ExxonMobil (XOM.N) as a 50:50 joint venture, has tapped advisers at Bank of America to run a sale of the business, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter.
The companies are aiming for a roughly $8 billion valuation from a sale that could attract interest from private equity suitors, the report said, adding that the process remains in the early stages and may not result in a transaction.
Shell declined to comment on the report, while Exxon, Infineum and Bank of America did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

items.title: 米新規失業保険申請6000件減の19.4万件、約57年ぶり低水準に迫る
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン　２２日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン　２２日　ロイター] - 米労働省が２２日発表した１０月１７日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週比６０００件減の１９万４０００件となった。レイオフ（一時解雇）の少なさを背景に、申請件数は１９６９年以来の低水準となった７月中旬の１８万９０００件に迫る水準にある。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は２０万件だった。

週ごとの変動をならした４週間移動平均は１０００件減の１９万７７５０件と、１９６９年以来の低水準となった。 

エコノミストらは、堅調な内需を背景に企業収益が伸びていることに加え、退職の増加やトランプ政権による移民取り締まりで労働力人口が縮小していることが、労働者を解雇から守っていると指摘している。ただ、中東紛争の長期化に伴う金融環境の引き締めや金利上昇が、来年の労働市場に悪影響を及ぼす恐れがあるとの懸念もある。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「政権の移民政策により労働市場は逼迫し、企業は財（モノ）・サービスの生産に必要な人手を確保できなくなっているため、既存の労働者を手放さない状況になっている」と指摘。「多くの産業において、突如として労働者が代替不可能な存在となっている」と述べた。

今回の申請件数データは、１０月の雇用統計の調査期間と重なっている。 

１０月１０日までの１週間の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は２万５０００件増の１７２万８０００件となった。 ただ、継続受給件数には、大学を最近卒業した人や、職歴が浅い、または全くないために受給資格がない人は含まれていない。

長期失業者の一部が、大半の州で２６週間に制限されている受給資格を使い果たした可能性もあり、これが継続受給件数が低水準で推移する一因となっている可能性がある。９月の失業期間の中央値は１１．５週と、約４年半ぶりの高水準に近いものの、９月の失業率は４．２％にとどまっており、労働市場がインフレの要因とはなっていない。

ハイ・フリークエンシー・エコノミクスのチーフエコノ ミスト、カール・ワインバーグ氏は「米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は、需要を抑制しスラック（需給の緩み）を拡大して、インフレ目標回帰を確実にするために金融引き締めが必要と判断すれば、来週にも自由に利上げに踏み切ることができる」と指摘。「雇用に関するＦＲＢの責務は明らかに満たされている」と述べた。

items.title: Nasdaq lidera queda em Wall Street em meio a apreensões com IA; preços do petróleo se recuperam
items.author: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Ragini Mathur
items.creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Ragini Mathur
items.summary: O índice Nasdaq, com forte peso de empresas de tecnologia, recuava mais de 2% nesta quinta-feira, à medida que as ações de crescimento perdiam força depois que os resultados financeiros das megacapitalizadas Tesla e Meta não conseguiram dissipar as preocupações relacionadas à IA, com a recuperação dos preços do petróleo contribuindo ainda mais para o mal-estar do mercado.
items.body:
O índice Nasdaq, com forte peso de empresas de tecnologia, recuava mais de 2% nesta quinta-feira, à medida que as ações de crescimento perdiam força depois que os resultados financeiros das megacapitalizadas Tesla e Meta não conseguiram dissipar as preocupações relacionadas à IA, com a recuperação dos preços do petróleo contribuindo ainda mais para o mal-estar do mercado.
Essa queda segue uma sessão forte na quarta-feira, quando Nasdaq liderou a alta em Wall Street, à medida que resultados robustos da SpaceX (SPCX.O) e da Super Micro (SMCI.O) reacenderam o otimismo em torno das ações ligadas à IA.
SpaceX caía 3,9% e Super Micro recuava 3,4% nesta quinta-feira, à medida que os investidores olhavam para além dos resultados financeiros e avaliavam os custos crescentes dos investimentos em IA e o prazo incerto para o retorno desses investimentos.
Tesla (TSLA.O) caía 1,9% depois que a fabricante de veículos elétricos reduziu a previsão de gastos de capital anuais, levantando dúvidas sobre o ritmo de suas ambições em IA e robótica.
Separadamente, a Reuters noticiou com exclusividade que alguns executivos da Tesla estão preocupados de que os comentários públicos do presidente-executivo Elon Musk sobre uma possível fusão com a SpaceX possam atrair o escrutínio dos acionistas e complicar as negociações do acordo.
As ações da meta (META.O) caíram 6,7% depois que a gigante das redes sociais lançou novas ações sem direito a voto para ajudar a financiar sua dispendiosa expansão em IA.
“O que torna essas empresas de IA mais vulneráveis é justamente o fato de já terem avaliações tão altas. Portanto, qualquer pequeno tropeço no mercado causará uma grande queda em algumas dessas ações”, disse Brendon Dashiell, gestor de portfólio de pesquisa de investimentos da Bogart Wealth.
“Acreditamos que os mercados continuarão instáveis, mas ainda estamos cautelosamente otimistas.”
Outras empresas do grupo “7 Magníficas” também registravam quedas, com a Amazon.com (AMZN.O) e a Nvidia (NVDA.O) caindo cerca de 2% cada.
As ações do setor de chips também caíam. Intel (INTC.O) registrava queda de 5,3%, enquanto AMD (AMD.O) , Qualcomm (QCOM.O) , Marvell Technology (MRVL.O) , Broadcom (AVGO.O) e Micron Technology (MU.O) recuavam entre 1,9% e 5,2%.
O renovado nervosismo fez com que o Índice de Volatilidade da CBOE (.VIX) subisse 17,86 pontos, após três pregões consecutivos de quedas.
Seis dos 11 setores do S&P 500 registravam perdas, liderados pelo setor de tecnologia (.SPLRCT) , que caía 1,6%.
Os índices de bens de consumo básico (.SPLRCS) e de saúde (.SPXHC) , no entanto, eram os que mais se valorizavam, à medida que os investidores buscavam setores defensivos.
Às 11h44 (horário de Brasília), O Dow Jones (.DJI) caía 310,68 pontos, ou 0,59%, a 52.545,41 pontos. O S&P 500 (.SPX) tinha queda de 104,17 pontos, ou 1,34%, a 7.653,00 pontos, enquanto o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) recuava 575,73 pontos, ou 2,15%, a 26.127,12 pontos.
O petróleo Brent oscilava próximo do maior valor em cinco meses, depois que novos ataques de militantes houthis na Arábia Saudita alimentaram temores de interrupções no abastecimento e de um conflito mais amplo no Oriente Médio.
A busca por ativos seguros empurrou o rendimento dos Treasuries de 10 anos para cerca de 5,0378%.

items.title: Sports Council refers LaLiga's Tebas to tribunal over Real Madrid comments
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The National Sports Council (CSD) has referred LaLiga chief Javier Tebas to Spain's sports tribunal after his comparison of Real Madrid's communication strategy to Nazi propaganda.
items.body:
The National Sports Council (CSD) has referred LaLiga chief Javier Tebas to Spain's sports tribunal after his comparison of Real Madrid's communication strategy to Nazi propaganda.
The CSD has asked the tribunal to assess whether the remarks may have violated rules protecting sporting dignity and decorum.
Tebas made the [USN:L6N4620UQ TEXT:"comments"] on Friday on social media and in response Real released a statement asking for the 64-year-old's immediate resignation.
Tebas said he was not comparing the ideology of Real or their fan base with those of the Nazi Party but merely the club's propaganda techniques. On Thursday, the CSD said it had raised the issue with the sports tribunal.
The CSD asked the sports tribunal to assess whether Tebas' statements were a "potential violation of Article 76.4.b of Law 10/1990 on Sport, which classifies 'notorious and public acts that infringe upon sporting dignity or decorum' as serious infractions."
Sanctions for such infractions include warnings, fines or potential suspension.
Tebas responded on social media shortly after the CSD made its referral public, again making the distinction between ideology and propaganda techniques in his Friday comparison.
Tebas also said the CSD could use Real's questioning of LaLiga's integrity as grounds for a similar referral.
"Defending the competition also requires responding to those who constantly discredit it," wrote Tebas. "It's part of my responsibility. And I'm going to keep exercising it."
Reuters has asked Real Madrid for comment.

items.title: StoneX vê salto de 7% no consumo de biodiesel no Brasil, se mistura subir a 16% em 2027
items.author: Roberto Samora
items.creator: Roberto Samora
items.summary: Um eventual avanço na mistura de biodiesel no diesel no Brasil de 15% para 16% em 2027 elevaria a demanda pelo biocombustível em 7% ante 2026, para 11 bilhões de litros, de acordo com o primeiro estudo da consultoria StoneX para o próximo ano, divulgado nesta quinta-feira.
items.body:
Um eventual avanço na mistura de biodiesel no diesel no Brasil de 15% para 16% em 2027 elevaria a demanda pelo biocombustível em 7% ante 2026, para 11 bilhões de litros, de acordo com o primeiro estudo da consultoria StoneX para o próximo ano, divulgado nesta quinta-feira.
A StoneX acrescentou, contudo, que o cenário para aumento da mistura de biodiesel é incerto, dependendo de uma decisão governamental.
"A expectativa é de que os testes para viabilidade até o B20 (mistura de 20%) sejam concluídos em fevereiro/27 e, a partir dos resultados obtidos, o aumento para o B16 poderia se materializar a partir de março", disse um relatório assinado pelos especialistas da StoneX Bruno Cordeiro dos Santos e Isabela Garcia.
Mas eles ponderam que não há sinais claros do governo "de que estaríamos caminhando nessa direção", apesar de a indústria ter capacidade de sobra, com uma ociosidade estimada pela consultoria para 2027 em 40%.
Um aumento da mistura poderia impulsionar a indústria de soja, uma vez que o óleo de soja é de longe a principal matéria-prima para a produção de biodiesel no Brasil. A associação do setor Abiove estimou nesta quinta-feira que as exportações do grão brasileiro [USN:L1N4680IN TEXT:"podem cair em 2027"], em meio ao crescimento do processamento doméstico, considerando uma mistura maior.
Dados da ANP citados pela StoneX indicam que a commodity representou cerca de 85% da produção do biocombustível, registrando alta de 8,2% frente a 2025.
Sem avanço na mescla, o crescimento nas vendas de biodiesel no Brasil seria de 1,2% em 2027, para 10,43 bilhões de litros, basicamente acompanhando o consumo do mercado de combustível.
A StoneX estimou ainda a demanda brasileira por diesel B, com mistura de biodiesel, em 71,4 bilhões de litros em 2027, alta anual de 1,2%.
A consultoria comentou que nos cenários, de B15 ou B16, o óleo de soja deve registrar crescimento de participação, "uma vez que a capacidade do setor de esmagamento em atender o biodiesel é compatível com o crescimento das vendas, enquanto outras matérias-primas, apesar de também registrarem volume maior, não acompanham a competitividade do óleo".
O esmagamento de soja estimado exclusivamente para a produção de biodiesel em 2027 subiria para 43,7 milhões de toneladas, versus 41 milhões em 2026, no caso de um B16. Com uma mistura mantida em 15% no ano que vem, o processamento da oleaginosa avançaria para 41,4 milhões de toneladas.
A demanda por óleo de soja para biodiesel subiria para 8,7 milhões de toneladas, para atender um B16 em 2027, versus 8,3 milhões com um B15, ante 8,2 milhões em 2026, segundo cálculos da StoneX.

Suspected spy for Russia arrested in Germany

Oct 22 (Reuters) – A Ukrainian national has been arrested in the German state Brandenburg on suspicion of spying for Russia, a statement by federal public prosecutors said on Thursday.

Germany has stepped up efforts to counter what it sees as escalating hybrid attacks from Moscow, deemed by Chancellor Friedrich Merz the biggest threat to his country’s security.

The suspect, identified by prosecutors as Vadym Y. under German privacy rules, had been in contact with a Russian secret service via an intermediary since at least July 2025, prosecutors said.

Show Full Article

Prosecutors said he gathered military-related intelligence, including information on the production of armoured vehicles, ammunition and explosives, as well as personnel and installations involved in securing NATO’s eastern flank.

While some of the information was publicly available, other details were solicited from individuals in the European defence industry, they said.

The Russian embassy in Berlin did not immediately reply to a request for comment.

MOUNTING THREAT

Merz said on Thursday the arrest did not surprise him and warned that there would be more such cases in the future.

Western officials have warned for months that Russia is mounting sabotage, cyber and other hybrid attacks across Europe to erode support for Ukraine.

Merz said on Wednesday that Russian disinformation campaigns and hybrid operations posed the greatest threat to Germany’s security, adding that Moscow was mounting a broader challenge to the political order established after the Cold War.

The suspect is due to appear before an investigating judge at Germany’s Federal Court of Justice on Friday, when he will be formally presented with the arrest warrant and a decision will be made on whether he remains in pre-trial detention.

(Reporting by Kirsti Knolle; additional reporting by Cian Muenster and Miranda Murray; writing by Linda Pasquini; editing by Matthias Williams and Ros Russell)

Oct 22 : Investors betting against US neocloud and data center companies have raked in $6 billion in paper profits so far this month, after fears their debt-fueled AI buildout was becoming unsustainable sparked a selloff. 
Short interest in CoreWeave, IREN, Nebius Group, Applied Digital and Core Scientific ranged from about 20 per cent to 26 per cent of their free float, according to data analytics firm ORTEX.
• Current short interest in CoreWeave stands at 23.7 per cent of its free float, up from 19.6 per cent at the start of the month, but slightly higher than the 22.7 per cent seen at the beginning of 2026
• Short sellers have made close to $1.7 billion in paper profits from CoreWeave trades so far this month, after the company's shares slumped almost 30 per cent

• Short interest on Nebius has climbed to 20 per cent of free float, from 15.4 per cent at the start of 2026
• Investors betting against Nebius have raked in $2.94 billion in paper profits so far in October, though they have recorded a paper loss of $3.33 billion year-to-date
• Short sellers of data center operators IREN and Applied Digital have recorded combined paper profits of more than $1.2 billion so far this month
• Data center firm Core Scientific also had high short interest at 23.1 per cent of its free float, with short sellers clocking $115 million in paper profits in October
• Together, about $17 billion of stock across the five companies is currently sold short and borrowing remains cheap for all of them, ORTEX said
• On Thursday, CoreWeave and Nebius shares fell more than 4 per cent in early trading, while IREN lost 6.1 per cent, Applied Digital shed 3.7 per cent and Core Scientific dipped 2.4 per cent

Source: Reuters

Oct 22 : IBM shares fell 6.5 per cent in premarket trading on Thursday, as analysts said part of the company's third-quarter software rebound was driven by deals delayed from the previous quarter, raising questions about how sustainable the boost would be.
Here are more details:
• About $250 million of IBM's software growth in the quarter came from deals pushed out of the second quarter, and the improvement was more modest without them, BofA Global Research analysts said
• IBM now expects annual software revenue growth of about 7 per cent to 8 per cent, up from 6 per cent to 8 per cent, but kept its overall revenue growth forecast unchanged

• Third-quarter revenue in IBM's transaction processing unit, which sells software tied to its mainframe computers, grew 9 per cent, though CEO Arvind Krishna said he doesn't expect that pace to continue and sees a more "normalized performance, especially going into next year"
• The rebound follows a decline in the unit in the second quarter, when weakness in IBM's mainframe hardware and transaction processing software cut more than five points from its growth, finance chief James Kavanaugh said at the time
• Bernstein said IBM's forecast suggests sales in the unit will dip slightly in the fourth quarter as the lift from the delayed deals wears off
• The stock had fallen about 15 per cent this year through Wednesday's close, including its steepest one-day drop in over a century in July after CEO Arvind Krishna said IBM had “faltered” in adapting to a shift in customer spending
• If current losses hold, IBM is set to lose more than $15 billion in market value
• At least 8 brokerages have raised their price targets on the stock, according to data compiled by LSEG.

items.title: Anthropic IPO stands alone as AI market jitters sideline others
items.author: Echo Wang
items.creator: Echo Wang
items.summary: A once-robust fall calendar for technology IPOs is down to just Anthropic.
items.body:
A once-robust fall calendar for technology IPOs is down to just Anthropic.
The AI lab is pressing ahead to hold its initial public offering as planned in the middle of next month after making its prospectus public as early as late October, people familiar with the matter said, cautioning the plan and the dates are subject to change.
Anthropic's planned IPO will test whether its position at the center of the booming AI business, which the company is believed to deem worthy of a potential $1.5 trillion valuation, can overcome a market environment that might typically prompt bankers and deal lawyers to counsel delay. Anthropic is expected to begin marketing its shares to prospective investors during the week of November 9, one of the people said.
Other companies in the artificial intelligence infrastructure and data center sectors have delayed their listings, facing a rise in interest rates that has helped fuel a punishing selloff in shares and bonds of AI operators such as CoreWeave (CRWV.O) and broader questions about the sustainability of AI spending.
The contrast underscores Anthropic's appeal to investors even as concerns about competition from open-source models and AI safety weigh on the sector.
Many large investors remain bullish on Anthropic’s prospects despite the fall turbulence, viewing the firm as one of the few opportunities to gain exposure to a technology sector that long-term investors cannot afford to ignore. Other issuers are reluctant to compete with Anthropic for institutional investors' attention and capital, two of the people said.
Anthropic didn't immediately respond to a request for comment.
VALUATIONS COMING UNDER PRESSURE The AI sector pullback follows a string of IPO delays and withdrawals since September, as market volatility and rising interest rates have made it harder for companies to secure attractive valuations.
Switch, a data center operator, and Nscale, an AI infrastructure provider, have pushed their IPO plans back to later this year, people familiar with the matter said, while stressing that plans remain fluid and subject to change. Nscale’s delay was partly driven by the need to address comments from SEC staff, one other person said. SoftBank-backed SB Energy has also postponed its listing, Reuters previously reported.
Switch, NScale and SB Energy didn't immediately respond to requests for comment.
South Korean AI chip startup Elice was among the latest to shelve its listing plans overnight. Blackstone-backed AirTrunk REIT and Nvidia (NVDA.O) -backed Firmus have also pulled or paused their offerings, Reuters has reported.
Oura's recent IPO has added to the caution among prospective issuers. The offering attracted little participation from long-only investors, a person familiar with the matter said, raising concerns about the depth of demand from institutional investors that typically provide a stable base of shareholders for newly listed companies.
SCRUTINY ON MULTIPLE FRONTS The retreat from AI infrastructure listings reflects growing scrutiny of the enormous capital required to build data centers and whether future demand will justify the investment.
Recent developments involving CoreWeave have added to concerns about a potential slowdown in AI spending, although some market participants do not expect such a downturn to materialize.
Nscale publicly filed its IPO registration statement in September, while Switch submitted its filing confidentially, Reuters reported previously. A confidential filing allows a company to work with regulators on its registration statement before disclosing financial and business details to the public. Companies typically publish the filing ahead of investor roadshows, when they begin marketing shares to prospective investors.

items.title: Spotify llega a 788 millones de usuarios, aunque sus ingresos decepcionan a Wall Street
items.author: Ashley Carman
items.summary: Los ingresos de Spotify llegaron a €4.970 millones en el tercer trimestre, mientras los usuarios activos mensuales aumentaron a 788 millones y los suscriptores de pago alcanzaron los 306 millones.
items.body: Bloomberg — Spotify Technology SA ( SPOT ) informó que sus usuarios activos mensuales crecieron un 1% en el tercer trimestre, con respecto al trimestre anterior, alcanzando los 788 millones, mientras que sus suscriptores de pago aumentaron un 2% hasta llegar a los 306 millones, cumpliendo con las expectativas de los analistas en cuanto al total de usuarios, aunque ligeramente por debajo de las previsiones en cuanto a suscriptores, según el consenso de Bloomberg. Los inversores esperaban 305 milreslones de clientes de pago y 788 millones de usuarios en total. Ver más: Spotify expande los audiolibros en América Latina y sube en bolsa: Citi anticipa alzas de precios Los ingresos totales en los tres meses que terminaron en septiembre ascendieron a 4.970 millones de euros (US$5.580 millones), según anunció la compañía el jueves, lo que supone un aumento del 16% con respecto al año anterior y una ligera disminución con respecto a las previsiones de Wall Street, que se situaban en 4.980 millones de euros. Los ingresos por publicidad aumentaron más lentamente, hasta alcanzar los 482 millones de euros (US$541,42 millones), por debajo de las estimaciones de 484,8 millones de euros. La venta de publicidad ha sido durante mucho tiempo un reto para la empresa, que ha tenido dificultades para convertir este segmento en un negocio rentable a pesar de tener más usuarios gratuitos que suscriptores de pago. Ver más: Spotify crece un 12% en usuarios gracias a su apuesta por nuevos productos Durante el último trimestre, Spotify anunció planes para expandir su negocio de audiolibros. Los audiolibros, que según la compañía generan ingresos —especialmente para los usuarios más frecuentes que pagan un extra para disfrutar de más horas de escucha—, llegarán a nuevos mercados, como España, México y Noruega. Los esfuerzos de Spotify en el ámbito de los podcasts, que ahora se centran cada vez más en un número limitado de programas de gran éxito, recibieron un impulso gracias a la renovación de su contrato con Joe Rogan, lo que le otorga a Spotify los derechos para vender publicidad en su podcast, que sigue siendo el programa más visto en Estados Unidos. Spotify también colabora con Amy Poehler en su podcast y tiene un acuerdo con Netflix Inc. para distribuir ciertos programas en su plataforma. El margen bruto en el tercer trimestre se situó en el 33%, coincidiendo exactamente con las estimaciones de los analistas para este indicador. Ver más: Spotify detecta más de 500.000 reproducciones falsas ligadas a apuestas sobre canciones La compañía ha seguido firmando acuerdos musicales con sellos discográficos y editoriales para desarrollar su próxima herramienta de remezcla basada en inteligencia artificial, que permitirá a los usuarios pagar más para personalizar las canciones a su gusto. Spotify se enfrenta a una creciente competencia por parte de numerosas empresas emergentes que buscan desarrollar funciones similares. La compañía pronosticó unos ingresos de 5.200 millones de euros (US$5.840 millones) para el cuarto trimestre y 818 millones de usuarios mensuales, cifras que coinciden en gran medida con las estimaciones de los analistas. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: AbbVie's skin disease drug reduces lesions in trial, company eyes weight-loss combination
items.author: Christy Santhosh
items.creator: Christy Santhosh
items.summary: AbbVie said on Thursday its experimental drug significantly reduced inflammatory lumps and abscesses in patients with a chronic skin disease, meeting the main goal of a late-stage study.
items.body:
AbbVie (ABBV.N) said on Thursday its experimental drug significantly reduced inflammatory lumps and abscesses in patients with a chronic skin disease, meeting the main goal of a late-stage study.
AbbVie is betting on the drug, lutikizumab, to broaden its immunology franchise, and supplement the growth from its blockbuster drugs Skyrizi and Rinvoq.
The company expects to begin testing lutikizumab alongside its experimental weight-loss drug, [USN:L4N3YF1R0 TEXT:"ABBV-295"], by the end of the year, AbbVie's immunology head, Kori Wallace, told Reuters.
The combination aims to address obesity, which can worsen the skin condition.
Lutikizumab was tested in patients with hidradenitis suppurativa, or acne inversa, a condition marked by small, painful lumps to form under the skin.
In the 1,400-patient trial, about 31% of patients treated with lutikizumab achieved at least a 75% reduction in inflammatory skin lesions after 16 weeks, compared with 23% of those on placebo.
BMO Capital Markets analyst Evan Seigerman said the drug's efficacy appears clinically meaningful, but may be directionally lower than competitors such as Belgian drugmaker UCB's (UCB.BR) Bimzelx and Merck's (MRK.N) experimental drug [USN:L4N45M10F TEXT:"tulisokibart"].
COMBINATION OPPORTUNITIES AbbVie licensed its weight-loss drug ABBV-295 from Danish biotech Gubra in 2025. It's designed to mimic amylin, a hormone that helps regulate appetite and food intake.
"Majority of patients with HS are obese and that weight actually drives worse disease activity. Bringing down weight with our anti-inflammatory could really lead to increased efficacy in patients," AbbVie's Wallace said.
The company is also testing Rinvoq, its arthritis and inflammatory bowel disease drug, in hidradenitis suppurativa, with late-stage trial results expected by the end of 2026.
Wallace said the company sees an opportunity for lutikizumab both as a standalone treatment and as part of a "one-two punch" with Rinvoq in HS.
RBC Capital analysts expect the market for hidradenitis suppurativa treatments to exceed $10 billion by 2035.

WASHINGTON, Oct 22 : The US Commerce Department said on Thursday it plans to award $389 million in research and development funding to four companies working on power semiconductor devices and critical materials to boost technologies like commercial fusion.
As a condition of funding, the US government will receive minority, non-controlling and non-voting equity stakes, the department said.
In recent months, it has awarded 19 R&D grants to semiconductor firms from a $10 billion fund approved by Congress in 2022. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said in a statement the awards will "accelerate American semiconductor innovation to enhance our domestic energy and power resources."
Reuters first reported the new funding. The department said it had signed letters of intent to provide four new awards:

• Washington-based Helion will receive up to $175 million to develop high-voltage power semiconductors and advanced energy power modules in fusion power generation. The semiconductors will power and use energy from magnets driving Helion fusion generators. Helion said the award will be accompanied by $50 million in new private investment funds. "Building fusion power plants at scale requires us to accelerate the development of technologies like semiconductors that are critical to making fusion possible,” said Helion CEO David Kirtley.
• Massachusetts-based Commonwealth Fusion Systems will receive up to $85 million to develop semiconductors for radio-frequency plasma heating, power electronics, fusion diagnostics, and radiation-hardened electronics.
• Commonwealth said the funding will help develop semiconductor technologies for robotic maintenance systems. "These innovations will be a vital part of our global effort to deploy commercial fusion," Commonwealth CEO Bob Mumgaard said.
• Vertical Semiconductor will receive up to $73 million to advance its vertical gallium nitride power semiconductors for use in AI data center racks. The company, a startup spun out of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, said the funding will help accelerate R&D of next-generation power transistors and speed domestic production of this technology to drastically improve efficiency and power density for AI data centers and critical energy infrastructure.
• Sibelco North America will receive up to $56 million to develop next-generation purification for ultra-high-purity quartz used in the semiconductor supply chain. Sibelco North America, part of Belgium parent Sibelco, said the funding for key quartz components in semiconductor manufacturing will be used for next-generation leaching technologies and a demonstration facility to support testing new products in North Carolina. Sibelco CEO Hilmar Rode said announcement "represents a significant step for Sibelco and reflects the importance of high purity quartz within the semiconductor manufacturing supply chain"

Source: Reuters

Oct 22 : England captain Harry Brook smashed the fastest double ton in One-Day International history and became the first Englishman to score 200 in the format as he powered his side to 429-4 against Sri Lanka in their tri-series match in Rawalpindi on Thursday.
The 27-year-old rewrote the record books by racing to his double hundred in 114 balls, surpassing the previous mark of 117 deliveries set by India's Shubman Gill.
In the process, Brook also eclipsed England's highest individual ODI score of 182, held by all-rounder Ben Stokes.
Brook's scintillating performance ended with the final ball of England's innings when he was caught by Sahan Arachchige off the bowling of Janith Liyanage.

items.title: WHO, Africa CDC say Nigeria Ebola patient not confirmed to have visited Congo
items.author: Clement Bonnerot, Anait Miridzhanian
items.creator: Clement Bonnerot, Anait Miridzhanian
items.summary: The World Health Organization and Africa's top health agency said on Thursday they had not received confirmed information that Nigeria's Ebola patient had travelled to Congo, after Ugandan authorities said the woman had also visited the neighbouring country before being diagnosed.
items.body:
The World Health Organization and Africa's top health agency said on Thursday they had not received confirmed information that Nigeria's Ebola patient had travelled to Congo, after Ugandan authorities said the woman had also visited the neighbouring country before being diagnosed.
Nigerian health authorities have said the country's first Ebola case in [USN:L6N4670RQ TEXT:"more than a decade"] involved a Ugandan woman who had recently returned from Uganda.
Uganda's health ministry said the woman had also travelled to Congo, where the outbreak was first declared in mid-May and has since become the [USN:L6N4421DF TEXT:"fastest-spreading"] on record.
Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention official Wessam Mankoula said Nigeria and Uganda were sharing information to establish the patient's movements and possible source of exposure.
"So far, there is no validated information (that) this case traveled to DRC (Democratic Republic of Congo)," Mankoula told an online press conference.
The WHO said information it had received about the case did not include travel outside Uganda.
"The facts which we have received is that the patient returned to Abuja on October 3, being away from September 16 in Uganda," WHO representative to Nigeria Pavel Ursu told the press conference.
Ursu said the focus in Nigeria was now on containing the viral infection and that the patient remained hospitalised, with her biochemical markers improving.
Jean Kaseya, Africa CDC director, told Reuters on Wednesday that the patient, the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat, arrived in Abuja after a two-week holiday in Uganda.
Patrick Otim, a WHO emergency response manager, said on Thursday the source of her infection was still unknown as health authorities were working to piece together her travel history.
One issue that is under investigation is which health facilities the woman visited in Abuja after the onset of her symptoms and before her hospitalisation 48 hours later, Otim said.
KENYA TRACES ALL CONTACTS OF FIRST CASE Separately, a senior Kenyan health official said authorities there had now traced all 135 contacts of the country's first Ebola case, which was [USN:L8N45S0GY TEXT:"confirmed on October 6"] and after which a further eight cases have been reported.
"We have been able to account for them 100%," health ministry director-general Patrick Amoth said. He said the last contact to be traced was a citizen of Uganda who had arrived in Kenya in early October on the same flight as the index patient but exited by road via the Namanga border post with Tanzania, which meant it took more time to find him.
Africa CDC is investigating whether the Kenyan case may have come into contact with the patient being treated in Nigeria, as both travelled from Entebbe airport on the same day, Mankoula said. Possible transmission between the two was "one of the possible scenarios" being examined, he said.
Ebola spreads through direct contact with the bodily fluids of infected people, whether living or dead. The disease can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding.
The rare Ebola species behind the current outbreak kills about half of those infected and has no approved treatment or vaccine.
So far the outbreak is confirmed to have killed about 4,700 people across the four African countries that have reported cases, according to the Africa CDC.

items.title: US weekly jobless claims near 57-year lows amid low layoffs
items.author: Lucia Mutikani
items.creator: Lucia Mutikani
items.summary: The number of Americans filing new claims for unemployment benefits dropped to near 57-year lows last week amid low layoffs, suggesting job growth picked up in October after September's underwhelming performance.
items.body:
The number of Americans filing new claims for unemployment benefits dropped to near 57-year lows last week amid low layoffs, suggesting job growth picked up in October after September's underwhelming performance.
The weekly jobless claims report from the Labor Department on Thursday, the most timely data on the economy's health, continued to show no material stress in the labor market from the oil price shock stemming from the US-Israeli war with Iran.
Economists say strong growth in profits amid robust domestic demand, and a smaller workforce against the backdrop of retirements and an immigration crackdown by the Trump administration, were shielding workers from layoffs. There are, however, worries that tightening financial conditions and higher interest rates because of the drawn-out Middle East conflict could undercut the labor market next year.
"The administration's immigration policies may have tightened up the labor markets where companies are unable to find the help they need to produce their goods and services so they are holding tight to the workers they have," said Christopher Rupkey, chief economist at FWDBONDS. "Workers are suddenly irreplaceable in many industries."
Initial claims for state unemployment benefits fell 6,000 to a seasonally adjusted 194,000 for the week ended October 17. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast 200,000 claims for the latest week. It was the sixth consecutive week that claims remained at or below the 200,000 mark. Claims are within striking distance of the 189,000 level touched in mid-July, which was the lowest reading since 1969.
The four-week moving average of claims, seen as a better measure of labor market trends as it irons out week-to-week volatility, dropped 1,000 to 197,750, the lowest level since 1969.
The claims data covered the period during which the government surveyed business establishments for the nonfarm payrolls component of October's employment report. The four-week average of claims fell between the September and October survey weeks, suggesting a pickup in payrolls this month.
Payrolls increased by 29,000 [USN:L1N45N170 TEXT:"jobs in"] September after rebounding by 133,000 in August. Payrolls tend to underperform when Labor Day falls relatively late in the month as was the case in September. Economists continue to view the labor market as still in a "low-hire, low-fire" state. But uncertainty from the war and tariffs on imports has stymied hiring.
Financial markets were little moved by the claims data.
HIRING REMAINS SLUGGISH The claims report showed the number of people receiving unemployment benefits after an initial week of aid, a proxy for hiring, increased 25,000 to a still-low seasonally adjusted 1.728 million during the week ended October 10.
The so-called continuing claims, however, do not include recent college graduates and others who are ineligible for benefits due to little or no work history.
Some long-term unemployed people may have exhausted their eligibility, which is limited to 26 weeks in most states, keeping continuing claims at low levels. The median duration of unemployment was 11.5 weeks in September, near a 4-1/2-year high. Still, with the unemployment rate at 4.2% in September, the labor market is not a source of inflation.
Economists said that reduced the need for the Federal Reserve to aggressively tighten monetary policy as it battles the [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"inflation fallout"] from the Middle East conflict. The US central bank in September raised its [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"overnight benchmark interest rate"] by 25 basis points to the 3.75%-4.00% range.
Economists expect the Fed to stay pat at its meeting next week and hike borrowing costs again in December.
"The Fed has a free hand to hike rates next week if it deems monetary tightening necessary to soften demand and increase slack to ensure a return to the inflation target," said Carl Weinberg, chief economist at High Frequency Economics. "Its employment mandate is clearly satisfied."
(This story has been corrected to clarify that the four-week moving average of claims was at its lowest level since 1969, in paragraph 6.)

FAST

Oct 22 : Indian digital trust services provider eMudhra on Thursday said it would voluntarily withdraw from the global SSL/TLS certificate business, following an incident in which its digital certificates were found to have vulnerabilities.
The disclosure of the vulnerabilities led to internet browser majors such as Google, Mozilla, Apple and Microsoft to block digital certificates issued by eMudhra, and sparked larger concerns among cybersecurity professionals around internet security and privacy.
SSL and TLS are protocols used to secure data sent between web browsers and servers, ensuring that private information cannot be intercepted by bad actors. eMudhra issues these certificates to digital businesses and government agencies, including for some online public services such as India's income tax portal.
An independent cybersecurity researcher found over the weekend that several key certificates issued by eMudhra, used to secure websites, software, and online communications, were weak and vulnerable to attack.

On Wednesday, India's Computer Emergency Response Team also issued an advisory saying that some of eMudhra's intermediate certificates were compromised.
The company, in its statement on Wednesday, said it withdrew eight certificates it had issued, and that its infrastructure was not compromised and no data was breached.
The level of social media amplification around the incident has brought scrutiny that is out of proportion with the significance of the vertical in the company, eMudhra said in its follow-up statement, adding that the global SSL/TLS certificate business contributes 1 per cent of its revenue.
eMudhra's customers include Indian IT services companies Infosys and TCS.
Shares of the company fell 40 per cent in the two days after the vulnerability was disclosed.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Tesla drops as spending pullback clouds AI, robotics ambitions
items.author: Reuters Staff
items.summary: Tesla’s shares slid five per cent in premarket trading on Thursday as the EV maker’s reduced capital spending forecast raised questions about the pace of investment behind Elon Musk’s AI, robotics and ...
items.body: Tesla’s shares slid five per cent in premarket trading on Thursday as the EV maker’s reduced capital spending forecast raised questions about the pace of investment behind Elon Musk’s AI, robotics and autonomous-driving ambitions. The company on Wednesday lowered its 2026 capital spending forecast to about US$20 billion from more than $25 billion after spending far less than expected on AI and robotics in the third quarter, which led to a surprise positive free cash flow. The strong position may prove valuable as CEO Musk explores combining Tesla with the far more capital-intensive SpaceX. But “investors are likely to come away with mixed feelings,” J.P.Morgan analysts, led by Rajat Gupta, wrote in a note. “The delay helps near-term cash burn but also suggests delays in investments that matter for fruition of long-term opportunities.” Wednesday’s management commentary suggested spending will be ramped up in 2027 and 2028 as Tesla continues to fund robotaxi, Optimus, AI compute and Terafab milestones, the brokerage said. Tesla’s shares have declined about 14 per cent this year, in contrast to the Nasdaq’s roughly 15 per cent gain. The stock is about 23 per cent below its record intraday high of $498.83, reached in December 2025. Its valuation, however, remains well above peers: Tesla traded at 188.24 times its forward earnings estimates, compared with 6.58 for Ford and 5.16 for General Motors. “The risk is Tesla now enters a period of limbo while investors await news on a potential combination with SpaceX, which ... might face significant regulatory hurdles,” said Russ Mould, investment director at AJ Bell. (Reporting by Joel Jose in Bengaluru; Editing by Joyjeet Das)

* En tanto, el dólar estadounidense se apreciaba frente al euro, porque la preocupación por los disturbios sociales en Francia y el deterioro de las perspectivas fiscales del país pesaban más que las inquietudes sobre el sector de la IA, que provocaba una caída de las acciones estadounidenses.
* "La IA está poniendo nerviosa a la gente, al igual que el petróleo... y Francia. Es evidente que hay un ligero grado de aversión al riesgo en el mercado", dijo Chris Scicluna, de Daiwa Capital Markets.
* El petróleo Brent tocó un máximo no visto desde mayo después de que nuevos ataques hutíes en Arabia Saudita avivaron el temor a una escalada del conflicto en Oriente Medio y a nuevas interrupciones en el suministro.
* El yen japonés se apreciaba un 0,51%, a 157,33 unidades por dólar.
* El franco suizo, otro refugio tradicional, se mantenía prácticamente sin cambios en 0,824 unidades por dólar.
* El índice dólar , que mide la cotización de la moneda estadounidense frente a una cesta de seis divisas que incluye al yen y al euro, subía un 0,14%, a 101,82, mientras que el euro bajaba un 0,3%, a 1,1198 dólares.
* La preocupación sobre la capacidad de Francia para gestionar su enorme deuda ha perjudicado a los bonos del Estado francés y ha avivado el temor por otros países muy endeudados de la zona del euro. El diferencial entre los rendimientos de los bonos a 10 años de Francia y Alemania alcanzó los 177,7 puntos básicos el jueves, la mayor diferencia desde 2011.

items.title: P&G supera las expectativas mientras mantiene su apuesta por precios moderados
items.author: Redd Brown
items.summary: Los ingresos orgánicos de Procter & Gamble crecieron 4% en el primer trimestre fiscal, su mayor avance en tres años, impulsados principalmente por el volumen de ventas y por alzas de precios limitadas ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Las ventas y los beneficios de Procter & Gamble Co. ( PG ) superaron las expectativas de Wall Street, lo que demuestra que los limitados aumentos de precios del propietario de Tide, que están atrayendo con éxito a clientes con presupuestos ajustados, no se han producido a expensas de las ganancias. Según un comunicado publicado el jueves, los ingresos orgánicos aumentaron un 4% en el primer trimestre, que finalizó en septiembre, lo que representa el mayor crecimiento en tres años. Ver más: P&G supera estimaciones, pero eleva el impacto de costos a US$150 millones Este dato superó las estimaciones de los analistas, que preveían un 2%, y se debió principalmente al aumento del volumen de ventas, lo que sugiere que las limitadas subidas de precios de P&G han logrado atraer a más consumidores en medio de una inflación persistente. Las acciones de P&G subieron un 2,4% a las 7:05 de la mañana en las operaciones previas a la apertura del mercado el jueves en Nueva York. Hasta el cierre del miércoles, la acción había ganado un 9,4% en lo que va del año, menos que el 13% del índice S&P 500. El fabricante de pañales Pampers se ha centrado en aumentar su cuota de mercado atrayendo clientes con menos subidas de precio, incluso ante la intensa presión sobre los costes derivada del conflicto en Medio Oriente. Los resultados demuestran que la estrategia está dando sus frutos, ya que los consumidores son más conscientes de sus gastos, aunque es posible que este impulso no se extienda a sus competidores más pequeños. Ver más: Las ventas de P&G crecen en América Latina: México destaca Según datos de Circana recopilados por Bloomberg News, P&G ostenta una posición dominante en los mercados de detergentes para ropa, pañales y pasta de dientes, entre otros. Esta amplia gama de productos de uso diario, con diferentes precios, parece estar ayudándola a sobrellevar la actual desaceleración económica mejor que sus competidores. La modificación de los precios mejoró las ventas en menos del 1%, mientras que el volumen de ventas contribuyó con un aumento del 2,4%. Los beneficios de P&G, excluyendo algunos elementos no recurrentes, se mantuvieron estables con respecto al año anterior, superando las expectativas de una caída del 5% y revirtiendo los descensos que había registrado en julio. Si bien los costos de materiales y transporte siguen aumentando, el impulso de la empresa a la productividad está limitando el impacto. Ver más: P&G nombra al brasileño Tirso Mello como su nuevo CEO en México P&G también mantuvo sus previsiones de ventas orgánicas y beneficios para todo el año, aunque elevó su estimación de costes de materias primas a US$1.400 millones, frente a los US$1.000 millones anteriores. Incluyendo los elevados gastos por tipos de interés y tipo de cambio, la compañía afirmó que estos factores supondrán un lastre estimado del 11% para el crecimiento de sus beneficios.
