items.title: Insider: Evonik prüft Übernahme von US-Rivale Ashland
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Der Spezialchemiekonzern Evonik prüft zwei Insidern zufolge eine Übernahme des US-Konkurrenten Ashland. Zwei mit den Bestrebungen vertraute Personen sagten am Donnerstag der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters, Evonik sei einer von mehreren Interessenten für das Unternehmen, das an der New Yorker Börse mit 3,3 Milliarden Dollar bewertet wird. Ashland habe auf Druck von aktivistischen Investoren begonnen, nach Interessenten Ausschau zu halten, sagte einer der Insider. Der Prozess - und damit die Bemühungen von Evonik - hätten noch vor dem Vorstoß von BASF zur Übernahme des Essener Konzerns begonnen. Das Vorgehen sei daher nicht als "Giftpille" zur Abwehr von BASF zu sehen. Evonik wollte sich dazu nicht äußern, Ashland war für eine Stellungnahme zunächst nicht zu erreichen.
items.body:
Der Spezialchemiekonzern Evonik (EVKn.DE) prüft zwei Insidern zufolge eine Übernahme des US-Konkurrenten Ashland (ASH.N) . Zwei mit den Bestrebungen vertraute Personen sagten am Donnerstag der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters, Evonik sei einer von mehreren Interessenten für das Unternehmen, das an der New Yorker Börse mit 3,3 Milliarden Dollar bewertet wird. Ashland habe auf Druck von aktivistischen Investoren begonnen, nach Interessenten Ausschau zu halten, sagte einer der Insider. Der Prozess - und damit die Bemühungen von Evonik - hätten noch vor dem Vorstoß von BASF (BASFn.DE) zur Übernahme des Essener Konzerns begonnen. Das Vorgehen sei daher nicht als "Giftpille" zur Abwehr von BASF zu sehen. Evonik wollte sich dazu nicht äußern, Ashland war für eine Stellungnahme zunächst nicht zu erreichen.
Das "Handelsblatt", das als Erstes über das Interesse an Ashland berichtet hatte, schrieb, Evonik wolle mit einem Zukauf in den USA die Abhängigkeit vom europäischen Markt verringern, Ashland passe gut in die Strategie, da sich die Portfolios unter anderem bei Kosmetik-Inhaltsstoffen und Spezialadditiven ergänzten. Neben Evonik hätten auch Finanzinvestoren wie Advent, Apollo (APO.N) und Carlyle (CG.O) Kontakt zu Ashland aufgenommen. Evonik habe die Investmentbanken Perella Weinberg und JP Morgan beauftragt, den Markt nach geeigneten Zielen zu sondieren.
Bei Ashland gehören drei als aktivistisch eingeschätzte Investoren nach LSEG-Daten zu den zehn größten Anteilseignern: Standard Investments (9,9 Prozent), Omega Advisors (6,4 Prozent) und Ancora Advisors (4,3 Prozent). Letzterer ist inzwischen mit zwei Vertretern im Verwaltungsrat von Ashland vertreten. Die Ashland-Aktie legte am Donnerstag nur leicht auf 72,46 Dollar zu.
Evonik würde mit einer Übernahme von Ashland größer und könnte damit von BASF schwerer zu verdauen sein. Ob sich der Ludwigshafener Chemieriese davon stören ließe, ist offen. BASF-Chef Markus Kamieth warb am Donnerstag in einer [USN:L8N4681R4 TEXT:"Videobotschaft"] mit weitreichenden Job- und Standortgarantien um Evonik und dessen Eigentümer. Ein Zusammenschluss sei eine "starke deutsche Antwort auf den globalen Wettbewerb", erklärte Kamieth. Vor dem Hintergrund wachsender Konkurrenz aus Asien und dem Nahen Osten müsse sich die deutsche Industrie konsolidieren, bevor sie von ausländischen Investoren aufgekauft werde.

items.title: Meta falls as investors balance Muse growth with rising AI costs
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Shares of Meta Platforms fell more than 5% in early trading on Thursday, as investors weighed the benefits of the company's fast-growing AI agent business against the mounting costs of funding its ambitious AI expansion.
items.body:
Shares of Meta Platforms (META.O) fell more than 5% in early trading on Thursday, as investors weighed the benefits of the company's fast-growing AI agent business against the mounting costs of funding its ambitious AI expansion.
As of Wednesday's close, the stock had gained more than 5% this year. If current losses hold, Meta is set to shed about $85 billion in market value.
The downbeat reaction comes despite Meta reporting stronger-than-expected quarterly revenue, forecasting fourth-quarter sales above Wall Street estimates and highlighting rapid adoption of its new [USN:L6N4500XV TEXT:"AI agent app, Muse"]
The earnings report came hours after a New Mexico judge ordered the company to pay a [USN:L6N4671C7 TEXT:"$25 billion penalty"] in a data-privacy case linked to Cambridge Analytica. Meta said it plans to appeal the ruling
The Instagram parent is [USN:L4N4671S3 TEXT:"spending heavily"] to support its AI plans, with an expected annual capital expenditure forecast between $135 billion and $145 billion. It also reported a free cash flow deficit of $2.12 billion in the third quarter, compared with positive free cash flow a year earlier
Deutsche Bank analyst Benjamin Black said Meta's AI investments were generating stronger advertising performance and engagement, creating a "positive thesis creep" around the stock as investors increasingly view computing infrastructure as a revenue-generating asset rather than a cost burden
Meta also announced plans to create a new class of non-voting Class C shares, giving the company additional flexibility for acquisitions and employee compensation while preserving CEO Mark Zuckerberg's voting control
At least 13 brokerages have raised their price targets on the stock after the results, according to data compiled by LSEG
Concerns about the scale of Meta's AI investments have also spilled into [USN:L4N4681E6 TEXT:"credit markets"], with the cost of insuring the company's debt against default widening to a record high

By Niket Nishant and Manya Saini
Oct 22 : SoFi Technologies on Thursday launched a "tokenized deposit" product that lets customers earn interest on cash set aside for crypto purchases, while offering protections similar to those of a traditional bank deposit.
Cash held in a SoFi Earn account will generate 4.4 per cent annual interest and be insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, which protects eligible deposits of up to $250,000 per depositor if a bank fails.

"Too much money in the digital asset ecosystem is sitting idle, leaving massive potential earnings on the table for millions of people," SoFi CEO Anthony Noto told Reuters.
The product moves SoFi into a space historically dominated by non-bank crypto firms. In recent years, funds earmarked for crypto trading were often parked in interest-bearing stablecoins, giving investors a way to earn yield while keeping money ready to deploy.
That model has come under pressure after the GENIUS Act, signed last year, barred stablecoin issuers from paying interest, creating an opening for banks to offer regulated, interest-bearing alternatives through products such as tokenized deposits.
SoFi Earn will also let users buy crypto directly or transfer funds to another platform.
"The primary opportunity is with people who already participate in crypto and want that money to keep working and ready to move," Noto said.
Traditional financial institutions are developing products to tap the crypto market, arguing that bank-issued alternatives offer greater regulatory oversight than stablecoins issued by non-bank entities.
In September, a group of 21 financial institutions including Goldman Sachs, Bank of America, Citi and Deutsche Bank, said they planned to create a company this year to issue a dollar-pegged cryptocurrency in the first half of 2027.
"Over the next year or so, you're going to see an inflection point. It is a big effort to move traditional finance on chain, but I think the economic drivers are just so powerful that it's inevitable," said Sam MacPherson, CEO at digital asset finance firm Spark.

In September, a group of 21 financial institutions including Goldman Sachs, Bank of America, Citi and Deutsche Bank, said they planned to create a company this year to issue a dollar-pegged cryptocurrency in the first half of 2027.
"Over the next year or so, you're going to see an inflection point. It is a big effort to move traditional finance on chain, but I think the economic drivers are just so powerful that it's inevitable," said Sam MacPherson, CEO at digital asset finance firm Spark.

Saudi Aramco tells staff to evacuate Dhahran as clashes with Yemen’s Houthis continue

Oct 22 (Reuters) – Saudi state oil company Aramco has ordered the evacuation of its headquarters in Dhahran, six people with knowledge of the matter told Reuters on Thursday, as fighting between the world’s largest crude exporter and Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis intensifies.

Clashes between the Houthis and a Saudi-led coalition that backs Yemen’s internationally recognised government have raged since the group pushed towards Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a shipping chokepoint at the Red Sea’s mouth.

The instruction to staff to evacuate the building and work remotely follows a wave of Houthi attacks on the kingdom, targeting the company and Saudi airports. The company did not immediately respond to a request for comment on what would be the first evacuation since the start of the Iran war.

Show Full Article

It was unclear what the reason for the evacuation was.

The kingdom’s benchmark index .TASI dropped 2.5% on Thursday following the Aramco news, according to LSEG data.

The renewed fighting between Saudi Arabia and Houthi militias in recent weeks ended a 2022 UN-brokered truce, which had largely halted cross-border attacks, and opened another front in the US-Israeli war on Iran.

The Saudi-led coalition said on Thursday it had intercepted drones over Riyadh and Islam’s holy city of Medina.

The Houthis caused extensive damage to Aramco’s headquarters earlier this month when they struck the building, with fire spreading across several floors.

Saudi Arabia has responded to Houthi attacks with a wave of strikes on missile launcher sites, vowing to protect the kingdom, and says it has intercepted many ballistic missiles fired by the group.

Houthis military spokesperson Yahya Saree said on Thursday that the group is rescuing a boat carrying 14 Indians that was attacked off Jabal Zuqar island near the strait, one of the territories the group seized in an advance in September.

Saree blamed the attack on Saudi Arabia. Saudi authorities did not respond to a Reuters request for comment.

HOUTHI AIRPORT ATTACKS

A Houthi attack on King Fahd International Airport in Saudi Arabia’s eastern oil hub of Dammam near Dhahran on Wednesday evening killed two people, a Saudi citizen and an Indian national, and wounded eight others.

Saudi Arabia’s General Authority of Civil Aviation said on Thursday that operations at the airport had resumed and air traffic had returned to normal.

The Houthis had warned airlines this month against using Saudi airspace as they have repeatedly targeted Saudi airports, including Riyadh’s international airport.

items.title: De la Espriella cambió abruptamente a su ministro del Interior: sale Lara y llega Alejandro Ordóñez
items.author: Daniel Guerrero
items.summary: El presidente anunció la salida de Rodrigo Lara Restrepo después de poco más de dos meses en el cargo y tras un revés que obligó al Gobierno a sacar por decreto el Presupuesto del 2027.
items.body: Bogotá — El presidente Abelardo De la Espriella anunció la salida de Rodrigo Lara Restrepo del Ministerio del Interior y designó a Alejandro Ordóñez Maldonado, exprocurador general de la Nación y embajador de Colombia ante la Organización de los Estados Americanos (OEA), como su reemplazo. El cambio se conoció tras las dificultades del Gobierno para sacar adelante el Presupuesto General de la Nación de 2027 en el Congreso. “Agradezco al doctor Rodrigo Lara Restrepo por su servicio a Colombia. Doy la bienvenida al doctor Alejandro Ordóñez Maldonado, quien asumirá como nuevo ministro del Interior”, escribió el mandatario al anunciar la decisión. De la Espriella no detalló las razones específicas del relevo. Sin embargo, el anuncio se produjo después de que el proyecto de presupuesto para 2027 se hundiera por un vicio de trámite, lo que llevó al Ejecutivo a expedir las cuentas públicas mediante decreto. El episodio representó un revés legislativo para el Gobierno y puso bajo escrutinio la gestión política de la cartera encargada de coordinar las relaciones con el Congreso. Mientras se formaliza la posesión de Ordóñez, el ministro de Justicia, Iván Cancino, asumirá temporalmente las funciones del Ministerio del Interior, según informó el presidente. El cambio constituye un nuevo ajuste en el gabinete durante los primeros meses de la administración de De la Espriella. La llegada de Ordóñez pone al frente de una de las carteras estratégicas del Ejecutivo a una figura con experiencia en la justicia administrativa, el control disciplinario y la diplomacia. Su trayectoria también está marcada por controversias relacionadas con sus posiciones frente al aborto, el matrimonio entre parejas del mismo sexo y el acuerdo de paz con las Farc. Alejandro Ordóñez Maldonado es un abogado y funcionario público nacido en Bucaramanga, Santander. Su carrera se ha desarrollado principalmente en la jurisdicción administrativa, el Ministerio Público y la representación diplomática de Colombia. Es una de las figuras más reconocidas del conservadurismo colombiano por sus posiciones religiosas y su oposición a varias decisiones judiciales relacionadas con derechos sexuales y reproductivos. Ordóñez es abogado de la Universidad Santo Tomás, sede Bucaramanga, institución en la que también cursó una especialización en Derecho Administrativo. Su perfil institucional ante la misión colombiana ante la OEA registra, además, un doctorado en Derecho y Ciencias Políticas por esa universidad y un magíster honoris causa en Ciencias Políticas de la Universidad de Salerno, en Italia. En el ámbito académico, ha estado vinculado a la enseñanza del derecho y a la investigación jurídica. Fue catedrático de la Universidad Santo Tomás en Bucaramanga y Bogotá, donde también se desempeñó como director del Centro de Investigaciones Socio-Jurídicas. Así mismo, impartió clases en otras instituciones de educación superior, entre ellas la Universidad Sergio Arboleda, la Universidad Católica, la Universidad Autónoma de Bucaramanga, la Universidad Autónoma de Nariño, la Universidad Nacional y la Universidad Industrial de Santander. La trayectoria pública de Ordóñez comenzó en la política local. Entre 1986 y 1989 fue concejal de Bucaramanga por el Partido Conservador. Posteriormente ingresó a la jurisdicción administrativa de Santander, donde se desempeñó como conjuez, magistrado y presidente del Tribunal Administrativo de Santander. En 2000 llegó al Consejo de Estado, la máxima autoridad de la jurisdicción contencioso-administrativa de Colombia. Allí ejerció como magistrado hasta marzo de 2008 y presidió la corporación entre 2004 y 2005. Ese recorrido lo posicionó entre los juristas con mayor experiencia en el ámbito del derecho administrativo antes de su llegada a la Procuraduría General de la Nación. En 2009, el Congreso eligió a Ordóñez como procurador general de la Nación para el periodo que comenzó ese año, el voto de Gustavo Petro fue crucial para su elección. Posteriormente fue reelegido y permaneció al frente del organismo de control disciplinario hasta 2016. Fue el primer procurador en ocupar el cargo durante dos periodos consecutivos. Después de dejar la Procuraduría, Ordóñez se vinculó a la campaña por el No en el plebiscito sobre el acuerdo de paz con las Farc. En junio de 2017 anunció su precandidatura presidencial para las elecciones de 2018, pero no llegó a la Presidencia. Posteriormente, el entonces presidente Iván Duque lo designó embajador de Colombia ante la Organización de los Estados Americanos (OEA), con sede en Washington. Ocupó esa representación entre 2018 y 2022, periodo durante el cual participó en la agenda diplomática colombiana ante el organismo multilateral. En septiembre de 2026, durante el Gobierno de Abelardo De la Espriella, regresó a ese escenario diplomático. La Cancillería confirmó el 15 de septiembre su posesión como jefe de la Misión Permanente de Colombia ante la OEA. Ordóñez llega a una cartera estratégica para la gobernabilidad del Ejecutivo. Entre sus responsabilidades estará la coordinación de las relaciones políticas con el Congreso, el diálogo con las bancadas y la articulación con autoridades territoriales y otros sectores de la sociedad. El contexto inmediato está marcado por el tropiezo legislativo del Presupuesto General de la Nación de 2027. El nuevo ministro tendrá que asumir la interlocución política alrededor de la agenda legislativa del Gobierno, la ley de ajuste fiscal, el estatuto antiterrorista y la ley de sometimiento, son sus principales retos. Su capacidad para construir acuerdos con sectores que no comparten sus posiciones ideológicas será relevante para el funcionamiento de una cartera cuyo trabajo depende, en buena medida, de la negociación política.

items.title: ＰＨＰ脆弱性、世界で修正急ぐ　攻撃試行は数百万件に
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [東京／北京 ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[東京／北京 ２２日 ロイター] - 世界各国の企業や政府は２２日、広く利用されているプログラミング言語「ＰＨＰ」で見つかった重大な脆弱性の修正を急いだ。サイバーセキュリティー企業によると、脆弱性の公表後に確認されたハッキングの試みは数百万件に及ぶ。

前日の２１日には、ウェブサイト運営者がＰＨＰを使うシステムの安全確保に追われる中、欧州などの政府が予防措置としてウェブサイトを停止した。ＰＨＰの開発者は、人工知能（ＡＩ）によって発見されるまで何年も潜んでいた脆弱性の緊急修正プログラムを公開、利用者に「直ちに更新する」よう呼びかけた。

世界各国で銀行、航空、鉄道、税務、行政のサービスが緊急停止し、公共・企業システムのＰＨＰへの依存度の高さと、脆弱性が明らかになった後に迅速に修正する難しさを示した。

マイクロソフトのサティア・ナデラ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２２日、ドイツのケルンで開いた同社のイベントで「ＩＴやセキュリティーに携わる全ての人にとって、長い一日、長い夜だったと思う。これほどの事態は長らく見たことがない」と語った。

今回の事態は、安全に保守が可能なデジタルシステム構築の重要性を浮き彫りにしたと述べた。

ベルギーのサイバーセキュリティー企業アイキドウ ・セキュリティーの共同創業者、マデリン・ローレンス氏は「修正プログラムの準備が整う前に脆弱性の詳細が公になり、攻撃が報告されている」と説明。「攻撃に備え企業は更新を急いでいる。まさに時間との競争だ」と語った。

クラウドサービス企業クラウドフレアによると、企業や政府が修正プログラムを適用し、予防措置としてウェブサイトを停止する中、ハッキングの試みは数百万件に急増した。

同社のマシュー・プリンスＣＥＯは２１日夜、「公表前の１０時間に、当社のネットワーク全体で脆弱性を悪用しようとする試みを数千件確認した」とＸに投稿。「公表後４５分で数万件、２時間以内に数十万件に跳ね上がり、今では数百万件に達している」とした。

日本では野村ホールディングス、三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループ、ＡＮＡホールディングス、ＪＲ東日本などが２２日、緊急措置の一環として一部のインターネットサービスを一時停止すると発表した。

東京海上ホールディングスは、グループ会社のウェブサイトを停止したと明らかにした。

財務省と気象庁は安全対策を実施するためオンラインサービスを一部停止し、国税庁もサービスを一時停止した。

予防的な停止措置は、日本でサイバーセキュリティーへの懸念が高まっていることを示している。トレンドＡＩのデータによると、２０２６年１─９月に日本で記録されたサイバーインシデントの件数は、２５年通年を上回った。

フランスの通信大手オレンジは、予防措置として、複数の子会社でＰＨＰを使う一部のウェブサイトやアプリケーションへのアクセスを一時停止したと説明した。

中国のクラウドサービス大手テンセントクラウドは、更新版のＰＨＰを導入するよう顧客に呼びかけたが、広範なウェブサイト停止を求めるには至らなかった。

フィンランドの政府ＩＴサービス機関バルトリは、前日に政府の一般向けウェブサービスを停止した後、夜間もＰＨＰのセキュリティー修正プログラムの適用を続け、予防的なサービス停止を段階的に解除していると説明した。「更新に加えてシステムを慎重にテストする必要があるため、サービスの復旧には数日、場合によっては数週間かかる可能性がある」と声明で述べた。

同機関は、サービス停止は脆弱性の悪用やサイバー侵害によるものではなく、脆弱性が実際に悪用された事例も把握していないと説明した。

アジアの複数の政府は２２日、ＰＨＰの脆弱性に関連するサイバーセキュリティー点検を指示した。

中国の工業情報省は、組織や利用者にシステムを直ちに点検し、安全性が確保された最新のＰＨＰに更新するよう呼びかけた。また、サイバーセキュリティー監視を強化し、必要に応じてアカウント、パスワード、鍵（キー） を変更するよう勧告した。

韓国はハッキング攻撃のリスク増大への懸念を理由に、民間部門のサイバーセキュリティー警戒レベルを引き上げ、緊急対応措置を発動した。

マイクロソフトのサティア・ナデラ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２２日、ドイツのケルンで開いた同社のイベントで「ＩＴやセキュリティーに携わる全ての人にとって、長い一日、長い夜だったと思う。これほどの事態は長らく見たことがない」と語った。

今回の事態は、安全に保守が可能なデジタルシステム構築の重要性を浮き彫りにしたと述べた。

ベルギーのサイバーセキュリティー企業アイキドウ ・セキュリティーの共同創業者、マデリン・ローレンス氏は「修正プログラムの準備が整う前に脆弱性の詳細が公になり、攻撃が報告されている」と説明。「攻撃に備え企業は更新を急いでいる。まさに時間との競争だ」と語った。

クラウドサービス企業クラウドフレアによると、企業や政府が修正プログラムを適用し、予防措置としてウェブサイトを停止する中、ハッキングの試みは数百万件に急増した。

同社のマシュー・プリンスＣＥＯは２１日夜、「公表前の１０時間に、当社のネットワーク全体で脆弱性を悪用しようとする試みを数千件確認した」とＸに投稿。「公表後４５分で数万件、２時間以内に数十万件に跳ね上がり、今では数百万件に達している」とした。

日本では野村ホールディングス、三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループ、ＡＮＡホールディングス、ＪＲ東日本などが２２日、緊急措置の一環として一部のインターネットサービスを一時停止すると発表した。

東京海上ホールディングスは、グループ会社のウェブサイトを停止したと明らかにした。

財務省と気象庁は安全対策を実施するためオンラインサービスを一部停止し、国税庁もサービスを一時停止した。

予防的な停止措置は、日本でサイバーセキュリティーへの懸念が高まっていることを示している。トレンドＡＩのデータによると、２０２６年１─９月に日本で記録されたサイバーインシデントの件数は、２５年通年を上回った。

フランスの通信大手オレンジは、予防措置として、複数の子会社でＰＨＰを使う一部のウェブサイトやアプリケーションへのアクセスを一時停止したと説明した。

中国のクラウドサービス大手テンセントクラウドは、更新版のＰＨＰを導入するよう顧客に呼びかけたが、広範なウェブサイト停止を求めるには至らなかった。

フィンランドの政府ＩＴサービス機関バルトリは、前日に政府の一般向けウェブサービスを停止した後、夜間もＰＨＰのセキュリティー修正プログラムの適用を続け、予防的なサービス停止を段階的に解除していると説明した。「更新に加えてシステムを慎重にテストする必要があるため、サービスの復旧には数日、場合によっては数週間かかる可能性がある」と声明で述べた。

同機関は、サービス停止は脆弱性の悪用やサイバー侵害によるものではなく、脆弱性が実際に悪用された事例も把握していないと説明した。

アジアの複数の政府は２２日、ＰＨＰの脆弱性に関連するサイバーセキュリティー点検を指示した。

中国の工業情報省は、組織や利用者にシステムを直ちに点検し、安全性が確保された最新のＰＨＰに更新するよう呼びかけた。また、サイバーセキュリティー監視を強化し、必要に応じてアカウント、パスワード、鍵（キー） を変更するよう勧告した。

韓国はハッキング攻撃のリスク増大への懸念を理由に、民間部門のサイバーセキュリティー警戒レベルを引き上げ、緊急対応措置を発動した。

items.title: ロシアとウクライナ攻撃応酬、ゼレンスキー氏「ロシアはクラスター弾頭使用」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Olena Harmash　Gleb Bryanski

[キーウ／モスクワ ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Olena Harmash　Gleb Bryanski

[キーウ／モスクワ ２２日 ロイター] - ロシアは２２日未明にかけてキーウを弾道ミサイルで激しく攻撃し、ウクライナはモスクワに向けて数百機の無人機（ドローン）を飛ばした。米国が戦争終結に向けて新たな働きかけを行っているが、両国は攻撃の応酬を続けている。

ウクライナ側は、ロシアが３波にわたり少なくとも２１発の弾道ミサイルを発射したと発表した。ロシア側は、ウクライナが夜間に首都モスクワに向けて無人機６３０機を発射したとしている。 

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、ロシアがクラスター弾頭を搭載した弾道ミサイル３発で首都キーウを攻撃したと明らかにした。ゼレンスキー氏によると、こうしたミサイルは目標に接近すると空中で爆発し、直径約４００メートルの範囲に被害を及ぼすよう設計されている。１発がキーウの歴史地区に着弾し、世界遺産「キーウ・ペチェールシク大修道院」の修道院近くが直撃を受けたという。

ベラルーシの国営ベルタ通信によると、双方は戦死者の遺体を交換し、ロシアが２５２人、ウクライナが２５人の遺体を引き渡した。

米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使は今週、ノルウェーの首都オスロでゼレンスキー氏のほか、欧州、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の当局者と会談した後、ロシアのプーチン大統領とサンクトペテルブルクで会談した。

ロシアのウシャコフ大統領補佐官は「米国側は（オスロで）いくつかの新たな変化を感じ取り、われわれに伝えた。しかし、そうした変化はわれわれが十分に満足できるものではない」と述べた。

プーチン氏とウィットコフ氏の会談結果について説明を受けたロシア高官によると、会談は比較的短く、踏み込んだ議論はなかった。ウィットコフ氏はオスロでまとめた一連の提案をプーチン氏に手渡し、検討するよう求めたという。

ロシア大統領府に近い別の関係者によると、米国の提案には、ウクライナがドンバス地域全域をロシアに割譲する見返りに、ＮＡＴＯから将来の安全の保証を受ける案が含まれていた。

＜米特使「プーチン氏は人道主義者」と称賛、ウクライナは反発＞

ゼレンスキー氏は２２日、ウィットコフ氏がロシア訪問中にプーチン氏を「人道主義者」とたたえたことに反発した。ウィットコフ氏は、ウクライナでロシア軍に拘束されていた７４歳の米国人の解放について、プーチン氏に謝意を示していた。 

ゼレンスキー氏はＸに「昨夜以降、ロシアの『人道主義者たち』がキーウに３波にわたって弾道ミサイルを発射した」と投稿した。「２１発のミサイルが使われた。残念ながら市内の多数の場所が被弾し、被害を受けた」と述べた。ウクライナの１０以上の地域が攻撃され、２人が死亡、子ども５人を含む３４人が負傷したと明らかにした。   

ゼレンスキー氏は、ロシアは引き続きウクライナのエネルギーインフラを標的にしており、１１日以降、重要なエネルギー施設に対する攻撃が１７０件を超えたとしている。

ロシアはオデーサ州の港湾インフラとウクライナ軍が使用する船舶に対し、夜間に「大規模攻撃」を実施したと発表した。

ロシアでは、ウクライナのドローンによりモスクワ近郊で２人が負傷したと、ソビャニン市長が通信アプリ「テレグラム」で明らかにした。ドローンの大半は遠方で撃墜されたという。

ウクライナと国境を接するベルゴロド州では、ウクライナのドローン攻撃で男性１人が死亡、別の１人が負傷したと地元当局者が明らかにした。

items.title: French debt risk premium reaches euro zone sovereign crisis levels
items.author: Stefano Rebaudo
items.creator: Stefano Rebaudo
items.summary: The premium investors demand to buy France's 10-year government bonds against safe-haven Bunds reached a fresh 15-year high.
items.body:
The premium investors demand to buy France's 10-year government bonds against safe-haven Bunds reached a fresh 15-year high on Thursday as concerns about the country's ability to repair its public finances, coupled with ongoing street protests, continued to weigh on sentiment.
French ministers have promised a vastly [USN:L1N4670D4 TEXT:"reinforced security operation"] during more planned protests this coming Saturday, with troops expected to be deployed alongside additional police.
France's benchmark 10-year yield rose 11.5 basis points (bps) to 5.11%, after reaching 5.1415%, its highest level since July 2002.
That pushed the French risk premium over German Bunds up to 173.58 - its widest since November 2011 during the euro zone debt crisis - reflecting investor unease about France's current fiscal outlook.
Political uncertainty ahead of next year's presidential election in France and Paris' [USN:L8N4660JK TEXT:"difficulties in passing a budget"] have further weighed on market sentiment.
"There exists a consensus that Europe is better equipped today to deal with crises, and that European institutions are stronger today than they were 15 years ago, which should make a European response easier to put together," Giada Giani, an economist at Citi, said, referring to differences between France today and euro zone periphery countries in the early 2010s.
"But re-emerging euroscepticism is a constraint here," she added.
The selloff in French government bonds persisted despite data showing [USN:S8N44Z00L TEXT:"industrial sentiment improved"] in October.
Charlotte de Montpellier, senior economist, France and Switzerland at ING, underlined that the rebound was a welcome surprise, recalling that when business confidence data was collected, the nature of the risk included political and financial consequences of social unrest.
BUNDS RISE ON SAFE-HAVEN BIDS Borrowing costs have risen this year as higher energy prices fuelled expectations of a hawkish central bank response, putting pressure on the bonds of highly indebted countries such as France. Bets on European Central Bank rate hikes have been quite stable in the last few weeks at around three additional tightening moves by late 2027.
Germany’s 10-year government bond yields , the euro area benchmark, were down 4 bps to 3.38%, supported by safe-haven demand, despite a rise in oil prices.
[USN:L1N46801N TEXT:"Brent crude futures rallied"] over $2 a barrel on Thursday after more Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia, while natural gas prices were just off their highest since December 2022.
Yield gaps over Bunds widened across the euro zone, with Belgium's spread widening more than 10 bps to 111.28 bps, its highest since 2012, while Italy's rose 10.5 bps to 123 bps, Spain's widened 7.5 bps to 71 bps and Greece's increased 8.5 bps to 102 bps.
The German 2-year government bond yield , more sensitive to policy rate expectations, fell 0.5 bps to 3.08%.
ECB chief Christine Lagarde said at the end of last month, when markets were pricing almost four hikes by late-2027, a [USN:L8N45K12P TEXT:"moderate policy response"] from the ECB remained appropriate.
Expectations for the ECB's rate path edged higher, with money markets pricing the deposit rate at 3.26% by late 2027, up from the current 2.50%, while expectations for December stood at 2.73%.

items.title: P&G warns of bigger cost hit from oil prices, even as consumer demand holds up
items.author: Juveria Tabassum, Alexander Marrow
items.creator: Juveria Tabassum, Alexander Marrow
items.summary: Procter & Gamble on Thursday warned that rising raw material, energy and freight costs would take a bigger bite out of annual profit, even as resilient demand for its beauty and home-care products drove first-quarter sales.
items.body:
Procter & Gamble (PG.N) on Thursday warned that rising raw material, energy and freight costs would take a bigger bite out of annual profit, even as resilient demand for its beauty and home-care products drove first-quarter sales.
The Tide detergent and Pantene shampoo maker now expects increased costs to reduce fiscal 2027 profit by about $1.4 billion, up from its previous estimate of $1 billion.
Pressures from high commodity costs are expected to increase over the next two quarters, Chief Financial Officer Andre Schulten said on a media call.
Still, shares of P&G rose about 5% after the company posted better-than-expected first-quarter results.
Commodity inflation has become a growing concern across industries, from [USN:L4N45U0P6 TEXT:"consumer goods giants"] to [USN:L4N4661G9 TEXT:"airlines"], as oil-price volatility following the US war on Iran pushes up fuel and transportation costs.
"P&G's results suggest the consumer is holding up better than feared," said Brian Jacobsen, chief economic strategist at Annex Wealth Management.
The company's results offer a gauge of the resilience of US consumer spending as higher fuel and food costs squeeze household budgets and push shoppers towards cheaper alternatives.
P&G also maintained its annual forecasts for organic sales growth of 1% to 3% and core earnings of roughly $7 per share.
Schulten pointed to rising gasoline prices, continued volatility in the Middle East and inventory shifts as reasons for caution, saying the company did not want to "get ahead of ourselves." He said 3% growth would be "healthy" in the current environment.
HIGHER COSTS SQUEEZE MARGINS P&G's core operating margin fell 80 basis points in the quarter ended September 30 despite 250 basis points of [USN:L3N3S80IG TEXT:"productivity savings"], including efforts to streamline its supply chain under new CEO Shailesh Jejurikar.
Progress will not be a "straight line," and volatility will remain a mid-term reality, CFO Schulten said on a post-earnings call.
Higher [USN:L1N460114 TEXT:"fuel prices"] have pushed up transportation and freight costs for packaged-goods companies, while a shortage of truck drivers on some routes has added pressure, a P&G spokesperson told Reuters.
US [USN:L6N45Z19G TEXT:"retail diesel prices"] hit a record $6 a gallon in September following the US war in Iran and have remained elevated.
P&G was trying to raise prices alongside product innovation, without jeopardizing top-line growth, Schulten said.
RESILIENT DEMAND LIFTS VOLUMES First-quarter net sales rose 4% to $23.28 billion, beating analysts' estimates of $22.80 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Its shares rose about 5% in early trading.
Volumes increased in P&G's beauty business, helped by demand for higher-priced hair-care products as consumers continued to spend on self-care despite pressure on household budgets from higher fuel and food costs.
Overall volumes rose 2.4%, while prices increased about 0.4% in the three months through September.
Swiss packaged-goods maker Nestle (NESN.S) also topped estimates for organic sales growth on Thursday, helped by stronger volumes.
P&G's first-quarter core earnings of $2 per share beat estimates of $1.88.

items.title: Comcast flags over $1 billion in restructuring charges in fourth quarter
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Comcast on Thursday flagged more than $1 billion in charges for the fourth quarter as it changes its organizational structure, ahead of the planned spinoff of its NBCUniversal business in mid-2027.
items.body:
Comcast (CMCSA.O) on Thursday flagged more than $1 billion in charges for the fourth quarter as it changes its organizational structure, ahead of the planned spinoff of its NBCUniversal business in mid-2027.
The company lost more broadband customers than expected in the third quarter as fierce competition chipped away at its core business, while NBCUniversal benefited from gains in theatrical and streaming.
Shares of the company were up 3% in early trading.
Here are more details:
Broadband users decreased by 144,000 in the third quarter, the company said, compared with the 116,800 losses estimated by analysts polled by FactSet and the 91,000 decrease reported in the year-ago period
Comcast's studios, theme parks and Peacock streaming service are set to separate from the company as part of the planned NBCUniversal spinoff

FAST

AMSTERDAM, Oct 22 : AI cloud services firm Nebius on Thursday said it had secured a $3.5 billion financing facility from Citi to fund continued development of its data centres and GPU purchases as it races to expand capacity.
The announcement comes against the backdrop of a selloff in shares last week related to AI infrastructure, after bonds issued by rival CoreWeave fell sharply in value. CoreWeave is usually grouped with Nebius as among the top "neocloud" firms that are building data centres specialized for AI.
The new Nebius facility matures in 364 days and carries an initial interest rate of 2.75 per cent over the term SOFR benchmark rate.
The Amsterdam-based company said the financing would give it greater flexibility over the timing and structure of further fundraising to support growth in 2027 and beyond. Its funding sources also include customer prepayments and operating cash flow.
Chief Operating Officer Ophir Nave said Nebius had other financing options available, including borrowing against more than $40 billion in long-term contracts with investment-grade customers, which include Microsoft and Meta .
"This facility provides additional financing to support our near-term capacity build-out," Nave said in a statement. The company has around $10 billion in convertible bond debt outstanding following a $5.75 billion issue in August.

items.title: UK regulator urges pension trustees to stress-test over AI concentration risk
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: British pension funds could have greater exposure to AI-related risks than trustees realise, Britain's pensions regulator said on Thursday, and urged them to challenge advisers on how a market downturn could affect their portfolios.
items.body:
British pension funds could have greater exposure to AI-related risks than trustees realise, Britain's pensions regulator said on Thursday, and urged them to challenge advisers on how a market downturn could affect their portfolios.
In a statement the Pensions Regulator, or TPR, said AI was increasingly embedded across sectors, meaning even an apparently diversified portfolio could have "hidden exposure".
It said trustees should assess both direct and indirect AI-related exposure across asset classes and stress-test how portfolios would perform under severe market stress.
Ben Gunnee, executive director of market oversight at the TPR, said all pension schemes must maintain standards of investment governance and manage risk over the short, medium and long term.
“That is why trustees should assess their AI-related exposure, test portfolio resilience and challenge advisers now to understand how market developments could affect their investments under different market conditions,” he said in a statement.
The Bank of England in a report in July also flagged the risk of a lack transparency in some AI funding arrangements may make it hard to identify the extent of the issue, meaning any selloff in highly valued AI stocks could have a very broad impact.
Global corporate investment in AI-related activity more than doubled in 2025, according to the Stanford Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence's 2026 AI Index Report.

As weight-loss drug users turn to dietary supplements, doctors, regulators raise flags

22 October, 2026 04:30 pm IST

By Nicholas P. Brown
NEW YORK, Oct 20 (Reuters) – For Allison Vecchio, 42, GLP-1 drugs were “a reset button on life,” but at a price — side effects like gastrointestinal distress, brittle nails, and feelings of weakness so intense that at times she could not leave her bed.

But the Fort Pierce, Florida-based ER nurse said the symptoms eased when she began a cocktail of supplements that included fiber, collagen and electrolytes, a haul that costs $200 to $300 a month. “You really have to take the reins” to turn mere weight loss into improved health, she said.

GLP-1 drugs like Novo Nordisk’s Ozempic and Wegovy rank among the biggest medical breakthroughs in years, owing to their efficacy in treating obesity and type 2 diabetes, and reducing the risk of heart disease. Some 10 million Americans used them last year, a figure that could grow to 25 million by 2030, according to JPMorgan research.

Show Full Article

Their side effects, though, have caused many to turn to loosely regulated dietary supplements.

US supplement sales have surged in recent years, surpassing $74 billion in 2025, according to the Nutrition Business Journal. While users swear by them, their growing popularity — fueled in part by social media — has doctors raising red flags and regulators considering new rules around how these products come to market.

Vitamins and supplements don’t need preapproval by the US Food and Drug Administration, making their scientific credibility hard to gauge. With social media personalities playing a growing role in their promotion, some medical researchers have called for more regulation of online supplement marketing.

Rob Fried, CEO of Niagen Bioscience, which had $129 million in sales last year, cautioned that companies “can hire an influencer, or even hundreds of influencers on TikTok … to make whatever claims will sell.”

SALES OF SUPPLEMENTS SOAR

Vecchio has 25,000 TikTok followers and is on retainer with three brands. She is also a member of TikTok Shop’s HealthPro creator program, which is reserved for licensed health professionals.

Pittsburg, Kansas, resident Terri Hart, 52 — a TikToker with more than 12,000 followers — mostly works on commission, perusing products the brands make available to influencers, and promoting the ones she feels helped her the most.

Hart takes magnesium, electrolytes, B12 and other supplements, which she says have helped offset what she called “horrible” nausea, fatigue and constipation after beginning GLP-1s in 2023. They run about $110 a month, costs insurance doesn’t cover. TikTok income eases the burden, Hart says.

She says she makes clear she isn’t a medical professional, and urges followers to talk to doctors before taking her advice. “I establish my authority through my lived experience,” Hart said.

TikTok Shop generated more than $1 billion in dietary supplement sales in 2025, or 5.4% of all e-commerce supplement sales, according to the Nutrition Business Journal, while overall US vitamin and supplement sales grew 5% in 2024 and 7% last year.

The drugs are “bringing in new consumers and expanding existing supplement routines,” said Erika Craft, a data analyst at Nutrition Business Journal.

But absent FDA preapproval, people don’t know exactly what is in many supplements, said Jonathan Bonnet, a clinical associate professor at Stanford and chief medical officer at the Ardmore Institute of Health in Ardmore, Oklahoma.

“If you can’t know what you’re taking, it’s hard to know what risks you’re undergoing,” he said.

RETAILERS OFFER MORE SUPPLEMENTS

Nearly half of GLP-1 users started taking new vitamins and supplements after beginning the drugs, according to a Nutrition Business Journal survey, with probiotics, protein and fiber particularly popular.

A consumer survey by Boston Consulting Group this year said GLP-1 users spend roughly 20% more on protein, fiber and collagen, a protein that helps maintain skin structure, than before starting the drugs.

Companies are capitalizing. Target is widening its supplement offerings, while private equity-owned The Vitamin Shoppe has seen double-digit sales growth this year in fiber and creatine, which are both popular with GLP-1 users, said Jack Gayton, senior vice president of merchandising at The Vitamin Shoppe.

Mergers and acquisitions in the space are getting bigger, though with fewer transactions. In 2024, there were 115 deals globally worth $7.3 billion, according to financial data firm PitchBook. In 2025, there were 95 deals worth $16.9 billion. Through October 6 of this year, there have been 68 deals worth $14.6 billion.

Procter & Gamble is set to acquire supplement maker Thorne, while Japan’s Kirin Holdings announced in August it will buy Canada’s Jamieson Wellness, whose US-based brand youtheory released a product aimed at GLP-1 users in early 2025.

Jamieson spokesperson Ruth Winker said the company sees GLP-1s as a tailwind for growth beyond combating side effects. “As people get healthier, they tend to take more vitamins and supplements,” Winker said.

REGULATIONS IN THE OFFING

US Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has proposed tighter regulations. The FDA this year has stepped up efforts to strengthen oversight of new dietary ingredients, issuing new guidance on what submissions for review should include.

Many supplement makers avoid this review process by using a pathway that allows food companies to declare ingredients “generally recognized as safe” without notifying the FDA. But a proposed rule would eliminate that option as part of Kennedy’s broader effort to regulate food ingredients.

The proposal has divided the industry. Some support more regulation, lamenting unscrupulous actors who spike supplements with drugs or add only tiny amounts of touted beneficial ingredients.

“At a minimum, a review process should happen prior to launch,” says Jacqueline Maslan, CEO of Body of Work, a vitamin startup aimed at women under 40.

But supplement trade group the Council for Responsible Nutrition says the rule would cause months of backlogs as the FDA reviews thousands of ingredients.

Thorne CEO Colin Watts said it’s “improbable” the FDA could have the manpower to review new ingredients “at the speed needed to keep up with innovation.”

In a statement to Reuters, an HHS spokesperson said the FDA is mulling opportunities “to modernize its regulatory approach to keep pace with an evolving marketplace,” adding the agency wants to ensure product safety “while supporting consumer choice.”

(Reporting by Nicholas P. Brown; Additional reporting by Neil J Kanatt in Bengaluru, Editing by Christian Plumb, Lisa Jucca and David Gaffen)

第４・四半期における月間アクティブユーザー数（ＭＡＵ）見通しは８億１８００万人。市場予想の８億１９００万人をわずかに下回った一方、プレミアム加入者数が１０００万人増加して３億１６００万人に達するという見通しは、予想の３億１４７０万人を上回った。

Oct 22 : Tesla's shares fell 2 per cent on Thursday after the EV maker cut its capital spending forecast, raising concerns among investors counting on heavy investment for Elon Musk's AI and robotics vision.
The company on Wednesday lowered its 2026 capital spending forecast to about $20 billion from more than $25 billion after spending far less than expected on AI and robotics in the third quarter, which led to a surprise positive free cash flow.
The strong position may prove valuable as CEO Musk explores combining Tesla with the far more capital-intensive SpaceX.
Capex is a delicate balance in this market, said Josh Gilbert, lead analyst at etoro. Investors welcome a larger budget if they can see returns, but a smaller one hints at slowing growth, he added.

"For a stock priced on Cybercab and Optimus, that (capex forecast cut) explains why the shares went nowhere on a result that beat on most measures."
Tesla did not break down the areas that would see spending cuts and the leadership on Wednesday attributed the adjustment to managing capital deployment efficiently.
Tesla's shares have declined about 14 per cent this year, in contrast to the Nasdaq's roughly 15 per cent gain. The stock is about 23 per cent below its record intraday high of $498.83, reached in December.
Its valuation, however, remains well above peers: Tesla traded at 188.24 times its forward earnings estimates, compared with 6.58 for Ford and 5.16 for General Motors.
Tesla and SpaceX have formed special committees to discuss a potential mega-merger, Musk said on Tuesday. The move could create an AI, cars, satellites and rockets behemoth worth about $3.5 trillion.
"The risk is Tesla now enters a period of limbo while investors await news on a potential combination with SpaceX, which ... might face significant regulatory hurdles," said Russ Mould, investment director at AJ Bell.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [香港 ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[香港 ２２日 ロイター] - 破綻した中国不動産開発業者、中国恒大集団の清算人は２２日、２０２４年１月に香港の裁判所が清算を命じて以来２回目となる進捗報告書を公表し、これまでの資産売却や貸付金回収を通じて４億３５９０万ドルを回収したと明らかにした。ただ、同社に対して約４６０億ドルの債権を保有する債権者への返済がいかに困難であるかが浮き彫りになっている。

清算人は、２７年上半期に債権者への第１回中間配当を目指すとしているが、その額は未定だ。

かつて中国最大の不動産開発業者だった同社は、約３０００億ドルの負債の大部分について債務不履行に陥り、中国不動産危機の象徴となった。

香港本社で発見された１０７点の美術品のうち９６点が２８８０万ドルで売却されたが、損失を伴うものだったという。このコレクションには、ピカソ、モネ、ウォーホルの作品に加え、ムーアやヘップワースの彫刻も含まれていた。

第４・四半期にはプライベートジェットも売却対象となっており、約１２００万ドルでの売却が見込まれている。また、清算人は、２０年に行われた寄付金の一部について、米国の大学に対し２００万ドルの返還を求めている。

業界の専門家らは、会社の規模と複雑さを考慮すると、恒大集団の清算が完了するまでには１０年以上かかる可能性があると指摘している。

items.title: Prada shows resilience in tough luxury market, hot weather weighs on shop traffic
items.author: Elisa Anzolin
items.creator: Elisa Anzolin
items.summary: Italian luxury group Prada on Thursday posted a 1% underlying growth in third-quarter revenue, broadly meeting market expectations and showing resilience as many peers reported declining sales amid a record-hot summer.
items.body:
Italian luxury group Prada (1913.F) on Thursday posted a 1% underlying growth in third-quarter revenue, broadly meeting market expectations and showing resilience as many peers reported declining sales amid a record-hot summer.
The underlying revenue growth excludes Versace, which Prada acquired in December last year. The group said the integration of the brand was "on track", ahead of the debut of the first collection by new creative director Pieter Mulier next year.
Extreme weather was the main factor behind weaker store traffic, Prada Chief Executive Andrea Guerra told an analyst call.
Prada experienced a significant delay in autumn-winter ready-to-wear sales during the quarter with demand picking up only in the last two-to-three weeks, Guerra said.
His words on the revenue impact of unusually warm [USN:S8N45H05M TEXT:"weather"] echoed comments by Moncler executives on Wednesday.
Including Versace, group revenue totalled €1.49 billion ($1.67 billion) in the quarter, rising 11% year-on-year and matching a Visible Alpha analyst consensus.
The result was supported by continued growth in the Americas, albeit at a slower pace compared to the previous quarter.
Sales in the Asia-Pacific region were stable, as mainland China's weakness was offset by continued positive trends elsewhere in the region, the company said.
Revenue in Europe remained weak.
Miu Miu, the group's smaller brand which accounted for the bulk of consolidated revenue growth in 2025, posted its first quarterly decline in sales since the pandemic. Miu Miu's retail sales fell 3% in the quarter.
"The third quarter unfolded against a particularly challenging industry backdrop. In this context, the group showed good resilience", Guerra said in a statement.
Asked about long-held plans about a secondary listing in Milan, Chief Financial Officer Andrea Bonini said Prada had no updates to share.
"It's an option that is worth considering from time to time, but at the moment we are not in a position to share any news," Bonini told analysts.
($1 = 0.8908 euros)

items.title: サウジアラムコ、本社退避を指示　フーシ派との戦闘激化
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Timour Azhari　Marwa Rashad　Olesya Astakhova

[ドバイ ２２日 ロイター] - 石油大手サウジアラムコは、湾岸の
items.body:
Timour Azhari　Marwa Rashad　Olesya Astakhova

[ドバイ ２２日 ロイター] - 石油大手サウジアラムコは、湾岸の ダーランにある本社から退避してリモート勤務に切り替えるよう従業員に指示した。関係筋６人が２２日、明らかにした。世界最大の原油輸出国サウジと、イランと同盟関係にあるイエメンの武装組織フーシ派との戦闘が激化している。 

今回の指示は、フーシ派がアラムコやサウジの空港を標的とする一連の攻撃を行った後に出された。イラン戦争開始以降では初の本社退避となるが、アラムコのコメントは得られていない。退避の理由は不明だ。

アラムコ本社には、世界最大の石油会社であるアラムコが陸上・海上の石油掘削施設や製油所、輸出ターミナル、総延長数千キロのパイプラインを監視するための操業管理センターがある。

サウジアラビア民間航空総局は２２日、東部の石油産業拠点ダンマンにあるキング・ファハド国際空港が２１日夜に攻撃され、２人が死亡、８人が負傷したと発表した。ダンマンはダーランの北約１５キロに位置する。

これとは別にサウジのエネルギー省によると、２１日には南東に数百キロ離れたアラムコのシャイバ油田の施設を攻撃しようとしたドローンをサウジの防空部隊が迎撃し、その後２人が死亡した。

サウジはフーシ派の攻撃に対し、ミサイル発射拠点への一連の攻撃で応じている。

フーシ派のサリー軍報道官はテレビ演説で、紅海沿岸都市ヤンブーにあるアラムコの施設と、首都リヤドのサウジ国防省を攻撃したと表明した。サウジ当局は攻撃を確認していない。

一方サウジ主導の連合軍は２２日、リヤドとヤンブーに近いイスラム教の聖地メディナの上空でドローンを迎撃したと発表した。

これとは別にサリー氏は２２日、海峡近くのズカル島沖で攻撃されたインド人１４人を乗せた船の救助を進めていると明らかにした。同島はフーシ派が９月の進攻で制圧した地域の一つ。攻撃をサウジによるものと非難した。

フーシ派は今月、本社ビルを攻撃し、甚大な被害を与えていた。

米当局者が２１日にロイターに明らかにしたところによると、米国務省はサウジにある在外公館の一部外交官と家族に退避を命じ、湾岸地域にある他の複数の米在外公館からも家族を退避させる方針だ。

FAST

Oct 22 : Artificial intelligence could boost global growth, but poorer countries, smaller companies and younger workers risk missing out unless access to power, digital infrastructure and skills improves, according to officials from the IMF and OECD.
The warning comes as massive investment in chips and AI infrastructure has helped support global growth and drive stock markets to record highs, while raising concerns about whether companies can generate sufficient returns on large spending commitments as borrowing costs rise.
"For many developing economies, the critical question is whether they can adopt and diffuse AI," Era Dabla-Norris, deputy director of the International Monetary Fund's Fiscal Affairs Department, told the Reuters Global Markets Forum.
Effective AI adoption could add up to 0.5 per cent to annual global growth over the medium term, the IMF estimates.

"But the aggregate productivity evidence, so far, is much less," Dabla-Norris said.
The Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development estimates AI could add 0.4 per cent to 1.2 per cent to annual productivity growth across its member countries. But its chief economist, Stefano Scarpetta, said that workplace use trails consumer use, with only limited adoption in core business functions.
"There is a large gap between exposure and actual use," Scarpetta said.
The IMF estimates that about 40 per cent of jobs worldwide could be exposed to AI, as reports of mass layoffs gather pace.
Barclays said it was cutting around 5,000 jobs this year as it uses technology including AI to reduce costs and improve returns. EBay is reported to be laying off 9 per cent of its workforce, while Qualcomm is expected to cut jobs globally in a "performance-focused reduction".
Dabla-Norris said younger and entry-level workers could be particularly vulnerable if AI takes over tasks through which employees traditionally gain experience.

Oct 22 : Publishing group Axel Springer would welcome any European initiative to separate TikTok from its Chinese owners along the lines of President Donald Trump's deal to split the US social media app from its parent, a spokesperson for the German company said on Thursday.
TikTok's Chinese owner, ByteDance, finalised a deal in January to transfer control of TikTok's US operations to an American-owned joint venture. The aim was to avert a ban in the US on the short-video app to allay security concerns raised by US politicians regarding the Chinese ownership of the app, which is popular with over 200 million Americans.
The comment from Axel Springer, owner of Politico, Telegraph Media Group and Business Insider, came in response to a Financial Times report. According to the report, Springer's CEO and co-owner Mathias Doepfner - who has repeatedly criticised TikTok - pitched an idea during a lunch in January with the US Ambassador to France, Charles Kushner, in which his company could be part of a deal to buy TikTok's European operations.
"As is clear from his public statements, Mathias Doepfner has always advocated for a European solution for TikTok along the lines of the American model," the spokesperson told Reuters. "Had such a solution materialized, Axel Springer would have welcomed the opportunity to be part of it as a major European media player."

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Die europäischen Börsen haben ihre Gewinne vom Mittwoch größtenteils wieder abgegeben. Für schlechte Stimmung an den Märkten sorgten anhaltende Sorgen rund um den Technologiesektor, negativ aufgenommene Konzernbilanzen und ein Anstieg beim Ölpreis. items.body:
Die europäischen Börsen haben ihre Gewinne vom Mittwoch größtenteils wieder abgegeben. Für schlechte Stimmung an den Märkten sorgten anhaltende Sorgen rund um den Technologiesektor, negativ aufgenommene Konzernbilanzen und ein Anstieg beim Ölpreis. Der Dax (.GDAXI) notierte am Donnerstag gegen Mittag gut ein Prozent im Minus bei 25.338 Punkten. Der EuroStoxx50 (.STOXX50E) verlor fast zwei Prozent auf 6096 Zähler. Zur Wochenmitte hatten beide Börsenbarometer um 1,4 Prozent zugelegt. Deutlich im Minus lagen auch die Futures für die technologielastigen US-Indizes Nasdaq und S&P.
Nach der Verschnaufpause am Mittwoch geht der Ausverkauf im deutschen Technologiesektor am Donnerstag weiter: In Frankfurt verloren Chipkonzerne wie Infineon (IFXGn.DE) und Aixtron (AIXGn.DE) rund drei und fast sechs Prozent. SAP (SAPG.DE) gaben trotz robuster [USN:L8N468059 TEXT:"Quartalszahlen"] ebenfalls leicht nach. Starke Quartalszahlen von US-Technologiefirmen wie Meta (META.O) und SpaceX (SPCX.O) hatten die Anleger zunächst optimistisch gestimmt. Der Optimismus verflog jedoch schnell, da die Anleger sich wieder auf die Kosten für KI konzentrierten.
Insbesondere der Plan von Meta, stimmrechtslose C-Aktien auszugeben, schürte neue Sorgen über hohe Ausgaben. "Aus meiner Sicht zeigt sich daran: Die Anleger wollen zunehmend sehen, wie aus hohen Investitionen dauerhaft höhere Gewinne werden. Die reine Wachstumsfantasie trägt die Kurse nicht mehr selbstverständlich weiter", sagte Salah-Eddine Bouhmidi vom Broker IG.
TURBULENZEN BEI ÖL UND ANLEIHEN HALTEN AN Auch Timo Emden, Chefanalyst beim Broker CapTrader, zeigte sich vorsichtig: "Der gestrige Kursanstieg sollte nicht über die jüngsten Unruhen in Frankreich gepaart mit weiterhin hohen Ölpreisnotierungen sowie Nahostrisiken hinwegtäuschen." Die Rendite zehnjähriger französischer Staatsanleihen stieg am Donnerstag auf rund 5,1151 Prozent und lag damit [USN:L8N4680NI TEXT:"erstmals seit 2013"] über der von vergleichbaren US-Staatsanleihen. Gründe für die wachsende Nervosität sind die hohe Verschuldung Frankreichs, die politische Unsicherheit vor der Präsidentenwahl im kommenden Jahr und Schwierigkeiten bei der Verabschiedung des Haushalts. Anhaltende Straßenproteste belasten die Stimmung zusätzlich.
Nordsee-Rohöl der Sorte Brent und US-Leichtöl WTI [USN:L8N4680QT TEXT:"verteuerten"] sich indes um jeweils rund drei Prozent auf 112,68 und 100,09 Dollar je Fass (159 Liter). Auslöser waren erneute [USN:L8N4672TO TEXT:"Angriffe"] der vom Iran unterstützten Huthi-Miliz auf Ziele in Saudi-Arabien. Zudem berichtete die Zeitung "New York Times", die Streitkräfte der USA und Israels hätten Pläne für erneute Angriffe auf den Iran nach den US-Zwischenwahlen am 3. November ausgearbeitet.
HERMES MIT KURSSTURZ - NESTLE RÜCKT VOR Gefragt bei den deutschen Einzelwerten waren vor allem die Aktien von Qiagen (QIA.DE) , die um rund 5,5 Prozent zulegten. Der deutsch-niederländische Diagnostik-Spezialist steht vor dem [USN:L8N4680AX TEXT:"Verkauf"] an den schwedischen Finanzinvestor EQT (EQTAB.ST) .
Europaweit zählten die Aktien von Hermes (HRMS.PA) mit einem Minus von fast sieben Prozent zu den größten Verlierern. Lange galt der französische Luxuskonzern als krisenfest, doch nun sorgte eine schwächelnde Nachfrage im wichtigen chinesischen Markt im dritten Quartal für einen [USN:L8N4680MA TEXT:"Dämpfer"].
Die Aktien von Barclays (BARC.L) begaben sich indes auf Richtungssuche und schwankten zwischen minus 2,7 und plus einem Prozent. Zuletzt notierten sie kaum verändert. Die britische Großbank hat trotz eines [USN:L8N4680ME TEXT:"Gewinnanstiegs"] den Abbau von rund 5000 Stellen angekündigt.
Gefragt waren die Aktien von Nestle (NESN.S) , die um rund 1,5 Prozent zulegten. Beim Schweizer Nahrungsmittelriesen zieht das [USN:L8N4680KA TEXT:"Wachstum"] an: Getrieben vom Geschäft in aufstrebenden Märkten und mit Heimtiernahrung beschleunigte sich das organische Wachstum im dritten Quartal 2026 auf 4,0 Prozent und übertraf damit die Analystenerwartungen.

items.title: ＰＨＰの脆弱性、韓国が緊急対応　サイバー警戒レベル引き上げ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル ２２日 ロイター] - 韓国政府は２２日、ウェブ開発用プログラミング言語「ＰＨＰ」に重大な脆弱性が見つかり、ハッキングの危険性が高まったことを受け、民間部門のサイバーセキュリティー警戒レベルを引き上げ、緊急対応措置を発動した。

大統領府の発表によると、国家安保室は情報機関、国防省、科学省の当局者を集めた緊急会議を開き、官民と軍の対応を検討した。

科学省は、最高情報セキュリティー責任者を登録している約２万８０００社と、政府の情報共有ネットワークに参加する５９００のメンバーのほか、重要インフラの運営事業者、ウェブホスティング企業、データセンターにセキュリティー対策を通知したと明らかにした。

政府は各組織に対し、ＰＨＰの開発者が２１日に公開したセキュリティー更新プログラムを導入するよう促し、すぐに修正できない場合は暫定的な防御措置を講じるよう求めた。

科学省によると、これらの脆弱性が悪用されると、攻撃者が認証なしで悪意のあるコマンドを実行したり、データを盗んだり、ウェブサイトを停止させたりする恐れがある。

items.title: TSX falls from four-week peak as miners, tech stocks weigh
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Canada's main stock index pulled back from a four-week high on Thursday as weaker gold and copper prices weighed on mining stocks, while tech shares slipped on fresh concerns over AI spending following Meta's quarterly results.
items.body:
Canada's main stock index pulled back from a four-week high on Thursday as weaker gold and copper prices weighed on mining stocks, while tech shares slipped on fresh concerns over AI spending following Meta's (META.O) quarterly results.
The S&P/TSX Composite Index (.GSPTSE) was down 0.8% at 36,032.84 points as of 10:13 a.m. ET. The benchmark had hit its highest level since September 22 on Wednesday after Canada unveiled a[USN:L1N4670YW TEXT:" multi-billion support package"] for sectors hit hard by US tariffs.
Copper prices fell to a[USN:L1N4680DY TEXT:" five-week low "]due to higher inventory, while gold prices dropped over 2% on increased expectations for higher-for-longer US interest rates
The materials sector (.GSPTTMT) , including metal miners, dropped 4.4% to its lowest since August 5
Tech stocks were impacted by fresh worries on AI spending after Meta introduced new [USN:L4N4671S3 TEXT:"non-voting shares"] on Wednesday to fund its costly expansion
Canadian tech stocks (.SPTTTK) declined 1.5%, with hardware solutions firm Celestica (CLS.TO) falling 7.2%
"The market is starting to get concerned about the spending. Celestica is very much linked to the AI trade because of the work that they do for some of these hyperscaler companies," said Brian Madden, chief investment officer at First Avenue Investment Counsel
Brent crude prices rose 2.6% to their highest since May after more Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia heightened fears of a broader escalation in the Middle East conflict and prolonged disruption to crude supplies
"There is increasing chatter that the US and Israel may step up the campaign with more airstrikes after the US midterm elections in a couple of weeks. So it might be a case of things getting worse before they get better," added Madden
Energy stocks (.SPTTEN) slipped 1.3%
Canada's September [USN:S0N3ZU02M TEXT:"producer prices"] increased 2%, compared with a 1.3% rise in August, amid higher energy and petroleum product prices
Logistics firm Mullen Group (MTL.TO) rose 8% to the top of TSX after reporting quarterly results above estimates

items.title: Irish central bank fines Coinbase unit €3.25 million
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Central Bank of Ireland fined crypto asset-trading platform Coinbase's Irish unit €3.25 million ($3.65 million) for breaching safeguarding and outsourcing obligations between 2020 and 2025, it said in a statement on Thursday.
items.body:
The Central Bank of Ireland fined crypto asset-trading platform Coinbase's Irish unit €3.25 million ($3.65 million) for breaching safeguarding and outsourcing obligations between 2020 and 2025, it said in a statement on Thursday.
The bank said the fine follows a settlement it reached with Coinbase Ireland on Wednesday, and came after rules related to protecting customer funds and maintaining confidence in the financial system were breached.
"Payment and e-money firms have a fundamental obligation to fully safeguard customers' funds," Central Bank Director of Enforcement Karen O'Leary said.
"The Central Bank has made its supervisory expectations in this regard clear: we have no tolerance for weaknesses in safeguarding arrangements."
A Coinbase spokesperson said it had self-reported the issues to the Central Bank and that "no customers suffered financial loss or were unable to access their funds as a result".
"These issues largely arose in the context of Coinbase taking steps to protect customers during periods of significant disruption," the spokesperson said in a statement.
Last year, the bank fined a Coinbase subsidiary [USN:L8N3WI1BC TEXT:"€21.5 million"] for breaching anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist transaction monitoring obligations.
($1 = 0.8915 euros)

items.title: Dow forecasts profit above estimates on pricing gains and cost cuts
items.author: Pooja Menon
items.creator: Pooja Menon
items.summary: Dow forecast fourth-quarter adjusted core profit above market expectations, betting that higher polyethylene prices and its cost-cutting measures would offset the impact from the rise in raw material and logistics costs due to the Iran conflict.
items.body:
Dow (DOW.N) forecast fourth-quarter adjusted core profit above market expectations, betting that higher polyethylene prices and its cost-cutting measures would offset the impact from the rise in raw material and logistics costs due to the Iran conflict.
The closure of the Strait of Hormuz following the escalation of the conflict in late February has disrupted oil and petrochemical flows, tightening global chemical supplies and driving [USN:L4N40C10N TEXT:"up"] plastics and polymer prices.
Global integrated polyethylene margins are expected to improve by about 2 cents per pound in the fourth quarter, Dow executives said on a post-earnings call.
Dow forecast fourth-quarter adjusted core earnings of about $1.54 billion, above analysts' average estimate of $1.38 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG.
The outlook builds on a strong third quarter. Dow reported adjusted earnings of 71 cents per share, beating analysts' estimate of 64 cents.
Sales at its packaging and specialty plastics unit rose more than 18% to $5.8 billion, driven by higher polyethylene prices.
Dow has been trying to reduce costs and improve profitability. It has been reviewing assets across its global portfolio, including plans to close higher-cost upstream facilities, and earlier this year, it announced plans to cut about 4,500 jobs, or [USN:L4N3YU1DD TEXT:"13% of its workforce"].
The Michigan-based company has implemented nearly 70% of its planned workforce reduction and expects its restructuring program to deliver more than $200 million in benefits in the second half of this year.
CEO Karen S. Carter said Dow remained on track to generate more than $1 billion in annual core profit gains in both 2026 and 2027.
Executives said Sadara Chemical, Dow's joint venture with Saudi Aramco (2222.SE) , had partially restarted, although logistics constraints continued to weigh on liquids production.
Sadara [USN:L6N40J0HD TEXT:"temporarily"] shut down production at its Jubail complex in March due to Iran war-related supply disruptions, and Dow [USN:L4N4160YF TEXT:"stopped"] recognizing losses from the venture in the first quarter after reaching its maximum accounting liability.

Oct 22 : Meta Platforms has a strong basis for arguing that the $25 billion penalty New Mexico secured this week in a case stemming from allegations the firm mishandled user data should be reduced on appeal, legal experts said. 
The judgment was one of the largest state verdicts against a company in US history. It came after a jury found Meta misled consumers about who had access to their data in the wake of revelations that Cambridge Analytica, a political consulting firm involved in President Donald Trump's 2016 presidential campaign, had harvested personal data from millions of Facebook users. 
New Mexico said state law allowed for a penalty of up to $5,000 for each time someone in the state may have seen an allegedly misleading statement from Meta. Experts said the company would likely argue that Judge Francis Mathew should only have considered people who actually saw the statements.  
"The most vulnerable basis on appeal is going to be the question about whether a violation is going to count, even in the absence of any proof that a particular person saw one of these misrepresentations or relied on them to their detriment," said Peter Ormerod, a law professor at Villanova University.

C.J. Mahoney, Meta's chief legal officer, said the company is confident it will win on appeal. The company is expected to appeal the underlying jury verdict and the penalty.
Meta has previously said that it does not sell user data and that New Mexico did not prove any consumer had actually been misled and that a penalty in the billions of dollars would risk violating its constitutional rights to due process and protection from excessive fines. 
New Mexico Attorney General Raúl Torrez said on Wednesday he expected Meta to appeal the judgment and the state stood ready to defend its legal position. He did not immediately respond to a request for further comment.
JURY FOUND 43 MILLION VIOLATIONS
New Mexico's attorney general sued Meta in 2021, alleging that the company lied to Facebook users about who had access to their data, how the company handled hate speech and misinformation posted on the platform, and other internal policies. 
Jurors on September 25 found that 26 of 29 statements made by the company and its leadership on those issues were misleading. Multiplying those statements by their potential audience within New Mexico, the jury said the company had committed more than 43 million violations of the state’s consumer protection laws. The state had 1.4 million active Facebook users and a population of 2.1 million as of 2020. 
Mathew said in his ruling on Wednesday that a penalty of more than $219 billion would be justified under state law, which allows a $5,000 penalty for each violation, but he reduced the amount.
The state had urged Mathew to award the state between $35 billion and $40 billion, while Meta said penalties of no more than $3.45 billion were warranted. 
Ormerod said that even if the company's appeals in state courts fail, Meta could argue to the US Supreme Court that the penalty violated its rights under the US Constitution to due process and against excessive fines. 
The size of the penalty on its own does not mean it will be overturned, given the New Mexico law allowing for penalties for each willful violation, said Daryl Lim, a professor at Penn State Dickinson Law. 
But it seems implausible that Meta was really responsible for so much financial harm, a sign the penalty may be unjust, said Eric Goldman, a professor at Santa Clara University School of Law.
"It felt like there was a lot of duplicative counting in the calculations," Goldman said. "How many times can a single person be duped by the same entity?"

items.title: As Trump's support slips, white evangelicals remain his Republican bedrock
items.author: Nathan Layne, Julio-Cesar Chavez, Jason Lange
items.creator: Nathan Layne, Julio-Cesar Chavez, Jason Lange
items.summary: With Republicans on the defensive amid record-low approval ratings for Trump, strong evangelical turnout could help the party limit losses.
items.body:
President Donald Trump is losing ground among many of the voters who returned him to the White House in 2024. But Reuters/Ipsos polling and interviews with white evangelical Christians show they remain his most reliable constituency and could prove crucial in the November 3 midterm elections .
With Republicans on the defensive amid record-low approval ratings for Trump, strong evangelical turnout could help the party limit losses driven by voter frustration over the cost of living and the war in Iran .
That loyalty was on display last week at Village Church, an evangelical congregation in Blythewood, South Carolina, where hundreds of worshippers gathered for a weekly “Bible and Politics” sermon by Pastor Erik Estep. The backdrop: an unexpectedly competitive race for a Republican-held US Senate seat.
Speaking in the main worship hall, framed by a giant video screen and concert-style lighting, Estep did not endorse a candidate or party. But as he spoke against gambling, following sermons on abortion and socialism, he urged his predominantly white parishioners to view politics through a biblical lens.
"I believe the church is the bulwark of truth for our nation," Estep said from the stage. "And it will take people like you and churches like this church to protect this nation spiritually and morally."
The message resonated with Karen Whiting, a 72-year-old retired pharmaceutical executive who plans to vote for Republican Darline Graham over Annie Andrews, the Democrat. Graham was appointed by the governor to fill the seat of her late brother, [USN:FWN43C0M3 TEXT:"Senator Lindsey Graham"].
Whiting cited concerns that Democrats would allow transgender girls and women to compete in female sports, echoing other white evangelicals Reuters interviewed in South Carolina last week who prioritized social and religious issues over economic concerns .
Andrews, however, said in a recent campaign ad that she opposes transgender women competing in women's sports and gender-affirming surgeries for minors.
"I’m voting for biblical principles, and I do not believe the Democratic Party stands for biblical principles,” Whiting said. “Without God, this country’s going to fail.”
If visitors to Village Church needed more explicit guidance on how to vote, a candidate guide available in the church lobby left little doubt. Produced by the conservative Christian advocacy group Palmetto Family Council and distributed to churches across South Carolina, it awarded Graham green check marks on all seven issues it rated, including restrictions on abortion medication and gender-affirming care, while Andrews received mostly red X's.
In a sign of the Senate race's growing competitiveness, Trump [USN:L1N4660VQ TEXT:"campaigned for Graham"] at a Wednesday night rally at Clemson University in South Carolina, focusing much of his criticism on transgender issues and falsely accusing Andrews of supporting the "sexual mutilation" of children.
Andrews offered a different reading of evangelical voters’ priorities. In a statement to Reuters, she said she had visited evangelical churches and met voters of various faiths, political persuasions and backgrounds, finding that they were chiefly concerned about the economy. “They're struggling with the cost of everything. That's why I'm running,” she said.
STRONG BONDS Reuters/Ipsos polling shows Trump's support among white evangelicals fell to 63% this month from 77% in January 2025. The decline is slightly smaller than his drop among the electorate as a whole, from 47% to 31%, and white evangelicals remain the only major demographic group tracked by Reuters/Ipsos where his support tops 60%.
The thrice-married Trump's bond with white evangelicals has survived a decade of scandals and investigations, including dozens of allegations of [USN:L6N43G12W TEXT:"sexual misconduct"], which he denies, and a [USN:O8N43T00F TEXT:"hush-money case"] involving a porn star. The question for Republicans is whether economic pressures and unhappiness over the Iran war, now in its eighth month, are weakening that bond.
Reuters interviews with 15 people at two South Carolina churches suggested that his hold on white evangelical voters remained strong. At Village Church and Carolina Baptist Church in the city of Spartanburg, about a 90-minute drive from Blythewood, only 2 of the 15 said they were considering Andrews, and none indicated they were abandoning Trump.
While several voiced frustration with the Iran conflict and rising gas prices, most said they [USN:L4N40Q1CN TEXT:"trusted Trump"] to keep Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon or, like Trump, [USN:L1N44A0QY TEXT:"blamed inflation"] on policies enacted under Democratic President Joe Biden.
Chad Connelly, an evangelical activist who heads the Christian voter-engagement group Faith Wins, said that while evangelicals "don't like paying higher prices," they are equally animated by social issues. Concerns about transgender athletes are "really playing everywhere" across the nearly two dozen states he has visited this election cycle, he said.
White evangelicals' loyalty to Trump reflects what Robert P. Jones, president of the Public Religion Research Institute, a nonprofit organization that studies religion and politics, calls a "grand bargain" forged during the 2016 election.
Many evangelicals have overlooked his personal conduct in exchange for his commitment to curtail abortion and LGBTQ rights, advance a conservative Christian vision of American life and pursue strict immigration policies that some supporters see as preserving the country's white Christian identity, Jones said.
"That has proven to be more powerful for this group than what they're having to pay at the gas pump," Jones, who has written extensively about the rise of Christian nationalism in American politics, told Reuters.
WHY EVANGELICALS MATTER White evangelicals make up about 13% of US adults but nearly a third of Trump's winning coalition in 2024, according to a PRRI survey and a validated-voter analysis by the nonpartisan Pew Research Center. More than 80% voted for Trump in each of his three presidential campaigns, according to Pew. They differ sharply from Black Protestant evangelicals, who overwhelmingly support Democrats.
Evangelicals' loyalty could also prove pivotal in Senate races beyond South Carolina that may help determine control of Congress, including in [USN:L6N44F10S TEXT:"Iowa"] and [USN:L6N45Z1B9 TEXT:"Kansas"], where white evangelicals make up a significant share of the electorate.
Opinion polls suggest the race in South Carolina is close. This week Trafalgar Group, a Republican-leaning pollster, released a survey showing Andrews trailing Graham by 3 percentage points.
Part of Graham's challenge stems from lingering unease among some conservatives over her appointment to the Senate seat. Even after a boost from Trump, the political newcomer only narrowly defeated US Representative Ralph Norman in the party's August runoff, underscoring questions among some Republicans about her experience and conservative credentials.
A spokesperson for the Graham campaign did not respond to a request for comment.
Yet even evangelicals lukewarm on Graham, like 53-year-old Kevin Thomas, said they felt they had little choice. Thomas, who attended the Village Church sermon and backed Norman, said he nevertheless did not trust Andrews on transgender issues.
“I’m leaning towards holding my nose and voting for Graham,” Thomas said. "I’m not willing to sacrifice six years of having a Democrat representing us in South Carolina."

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Patrick Wingrove　Marleen Kaesebier

[チューリヒ／ロンドン ２２日] -
items.body:
Patrick Wingrove　Marleen Kaesebier

[チューリヒ／ロンドン ２２日] - スイスの製薬大手ロシュが２２日発表した第３・四半期売上高は、市場予想を上回った。「オクレバス」など主力薬の需要が堅調だった。

グループ売上高は為替変動の影響を除くベースで７％増の１６１億３０００万スイスフラン（１９６億１０００万ドル）となり、同社がまとめた市場予想の１５７億５０００万フラン（１９１億５０００万ドル）を上回った。

ただ競争圧力の兆しも表れた。大型薬「ゾレア」は初の安価な後続品が発売された影響で、売上高が８億４８００万フラン（１０億３０００万ドル）と、市場予想の９億２５００万フラン（１１億２０００万ドル）を下回った。

株価は午前の取引で１．１％下落した。

診断部門の売上高は５％増の３５億４０００万フラン（４３億ドル）で、経営陣は、来年は１桁台半ばから後半の「通常」の伸びに戻る見通しだとした。中国市場について、医療価格改革による下押し圧力は和らいでいると指摘した。

ドルの対スイスフラン相場が安定しつつあることもロシュに追い風となった。グループ売上高の半分近くを占める北米市場で、長引いていた為替の悪影響が和らいだ。

医薬品部門は主力薬がけん引した。中でも多発性硬化症の注射薬オクレバスは、売上高が為替変動の影響を除くベースで９％増の１８億４０００万フラン（２２億４０００万ドル）となった。

items.title: Spotify forecasts strong profit as AI features start to pay off, shares surge
items.author: Jaspreet Singh
items.creator: Jaspreet Singh
items.summary: Spotify forecast fourth-quarter profit above Wall Street estimates on Thursday, banking on its AI-powered features to drive user growth ahead of the crucial holiday season.
items.body:
Spotify (SPOT.N) forecast fourth-quarter profit above Wall Street estimates on Thursday, banking on its AI-powered features to drive user growth ahead of the crucial holiday season.
Shares of the Swedish music streaming company rose more than 9% in early trading, hitting their highest since January.
New features such as AI DJ, which curates personalized music mixes with spoken commentary, and prompt-based playlists that let users describe a mood or listening preference to generate tailored selections have helped the company attract users amid the rise of music-generation rivals such as Suno and Udio.
The "About the Song" feature that allows listeners to check out facts and stories about the song was on its way to 100 million users and almost 40 million premium users now listen to mixed playlists, Co-CEO Gustav Soderstrom said on a post-earnings call.
Spotify expects operating income of €820 million ($920.53 million) for the fourth quarter, compared with analysts' average estimate of €813.4 million, according to data compiled by LSEG.
"We have admittedly been too cautious on AI's near-term impact, and the results show no damage so far," Pivotal Research Group analyst Jeff Wlodarczak said in a note to clients.
Spotify's forecast for an increase of about 10 million in premium subscribers for the fourth quarter to 316 million was above expectations of 314.7 million, even as its monthly active users expectation of 818 million was marginally below Visible Alpha estimates of 819 million.
The company's monthly active users ticked up 1% sequentially in the third quarter to reach 788 million.
Earlier this week, Spotify announced a licensing deal with music distributor Believe for its upcoming paid tool for fan-made AI covers and remixes. It has signed similar deals with Universal Music Group (UMG.AS) , Merlin and Kobalt for the tool.
In the third quarter, Spotify's operating income of €672 million came in line with Visible Alpha-compiled analysts' average estimate of €671.8 million.
Spotify has said growth in operating expense will peak in the third quarter and moderate from the fourth quarter, continuing into 2027.
Investors have closely watched the company's profitability as it spends on AI to improve discovery and engagement.
It posted revenue of €4.97 billion in the three months ended September 30, compared with an LSEG-compiled estimate of €4.98 billion. It reported earnings per share of €2.48, compared with estimates of €2.80.
($1 = 0.8908 euros)

items.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝ＡＩ関連主導で下落、ＣＳＩ３００弱気相場入り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [上海／香港 ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[上海／香港 ２２日 ロイター] - 中国・香港株式市場は下落。中国の主要株価指数ＣＳＩ３００指数は１５カ月ぶりの安値となり弱気相場入りが確認された。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株が、成長とバリュエーションの持続性に対する懸念から急落したことが背景。

ＣＳＩ３００指数は１．８％下落し、４０３６．３０で終了。２０２５年７月以来の安値となった。６月２２日に付けた終値ベースの直近高値から２０．２％下落し、弱気相場の目安とされる２０％下落の水準を超えた。

終値ベースでは、同指数は２００７年に付けた高値を更新しておらず、６月に相場を５年ぶりの高値に押し上げた勢いはその後急速に反転した。

香港のロータス・アセット・マネジメントのマネジングパートナー兼最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）、ハオ・ホン氏は「市場は底なしの状況だ」と述べた。

上海総合指数は１．５％下落して終了し１年超ぶりの安値となった。

アジア全域のハイテク主力株に広がった売り、低調な景気刺激策への期待、新たな材料の欠如を背景に、中国市場で広範な売りが加速した。

上昇したのは生活必需品指数と公益事業指数のみ。

ホン氏は「国家隊はためらっている」とし、売り局面でしばしば介入する中国の国有投資ファンドに言及した。

ＣＳＩ半導体指数は３．６％下落、ＣＳＩ人工知能指数は３．３％下落した。深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」総合指数は４．４％急落し、２５年７月以来の安値を付けた。

トレーダーやアナリストによると、中国政府の小出しの景気刺激策への失望も市場心理の重しとなっている。また、第３・四半期の経済成長率が予想を上回ったことで、追加の政策支援への期待が後退した。

＜課税問題が重しとなる香港市場＞

香港市場では、ハンセン指数が３％下落し、４カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。ハンセンテック指数は５％下落し、２年ぶりの安値となった。

一部の投資家は、香港上場の中国企業の株主の多くが採用している一般的な仕組みであるオフショア信託に対し、中国政府が所得税の徴収を進める取り組みを、売り圧力のもう一つの要因として指摘した。

ロータスのホン氏は、きょうが税申告の最終日だと指摘。過去数週間の売りは、中国企業の創業者らが主導したとし「納税義務を果たすための現金を調達するため、資産を売却していたのは明らかだ」と述べた。

２２日の下落が大きかった銘柄では、テンセントが２．９％下落、アリババが６％超急落した。

盛期資本（香港）のゼン・ウェンカイＣＩＯは「これほど急激かつ急速な下落は非常にまれで、特にテンセントのような主力銘柄ではなおさらだ。これはおそらくパニック売りの最終局面で、市場の売りは終わりに近づいている」と説明。「ただ、これほどの傷からの回復には時間がかかるだろう」と語った。

ＣＳＩ３００指数は１．８％下落し、４０３６．３０で終了。２０２５年７月以来の安値となった。６月２２日に付けた終値ベースの直近高値から２０．２％下落し、弱気相場の目安とされる２０％下落の水準を超えた。

終値ベースでは、同指数は２００７年に付けた高値を更新しておらず、６月に相場を５年ぶりの高値に押し上げた勢いはその後急速に反転した。

香港のロータス・アセット・マネジメントのマネジングパートナー兼最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）、ハオ・ホン氏は「市場は底なしの状況だ」と述べた。

上海総合指数は１．５％下落して終了し１年超ぶりの安値となった。

アジア全域のハイテク主力株に広がった売り、低調な景気刺激策への期待、新たな材料の欠如を背景に、中国市場で広範な売りが加速した。

上昇したのは生活必需品指数と公益事業指数のみ。

ホン氏は「国家隊はためらっている」とし、売り局面でしばしば介入する中国の国有投資ファンドに言及した。

ＣＳＩ半導体指数は３．６％下落、ＣＳＩ人工知能指数は３．３％下落した。深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」総合指数は４．４％急落し、２５年７月以来の安値を付けた。

トレーダーやアナリストによると、中国政府の小出しの景気刺激策への失望も市場心理の重しとなっている。また、第３・四半期の経済成長率が予想を上回ったことで、追加の政策支援への期待が後退した。

＜課税問題が重しとなる香港市場＞

香港市場では、ハンセン指数が３％下落し、４カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。ハンセンテック指数は５％下落し、２年ぶりの安値となった。

一部の投資家は、香港上場の中国企業の株主の多くが採用している一般的な仕組みであるオフショア信託に対し、中国政府が所得税の徴収を進める取り組みを、売り圧力のもう一つの要因として指摘した。

ロータスのホン氏は、きょうが税申告の最終日だと指摘。過去数週間の売りは、中国企業の創業者らが主導したとし「納税義務を果たすための現金を調達するため、資産を売却していたのは明らかだ」と述べた。

２２日の下落が大きかった銘柄では、テンセントが２．９％下落、アリババが６％超急落した。

盛期資本（香港）のゼン・ウェンカイＣＩＯは「これほど急激かつ急速な下落は非常にまれで、特にテンセントのような主力銘柄ではなおさらだ。これはおそらくパニック売りの最終局面で、市場の売りは終わりに近づいている」と説明。「ただ、これほどの傷からの回復には時間がかかるだろう」と語った。
